definitions.name: 09aa11bb-87ec-409f-bf0b-49b7c1561a87
definitions.display_name: Azure Cache for Redis Enterprise should use customer-managed keys for encrypting disk data
definitions.description: Use customer-managed keys (CMK) to manage the encryption at rest of your on-disk data. By default, customer data is encrypted with platform-managed keys (PMK), but customer-managed keys are commonly required to meet regulatory compliance standards. Customer-managed keys enable the data to be encrypted with an Azure Key Vault key created and owned by you. You have full control and responsibility for the key lifecycle, including rotation and management. Learn more at https://aka.ms/RedisCMK.

definitions.name: 09ce66bc-1220-4153-8104-e3f51c936913

definitions.description: Enforce backup for all virtual machines by backing to an existing central Recovery Services vault in the same location. Useful when a central team is managing backups for all resources across subscriptions. Exclude virtual machines containing the specified tag to control the scope of assignment. See https://aka.ms/AzureVMCentralBackupExcludeTag.

backupPolicyId.description: Specify the id of the Azure backup policy to configure backup of the virtual machines. The selected Azure backup policy should be of type Azure virtual machine. This policy needs to be in a vault that is present in the location chosen above. For example - /subscriptions/<SubscriptionId>/resourceGroups/<resourceGroupName>/providers/Microsoft.RecoveryServices/vaults/<VaultName>/backupPolicies/<BackupPolicyName>.

vaultLocation.description: Specify the location of the VMs that you want to protect. VMs should be backed up to a vault in the same location. For example - southeastasia.

definitions.name: 0a075868-4c26-42ef-914c-5bc007359560

definitions.description: Private endpoint connections enforce secure communication by enabling private connectivity to Azure Database for MariaDB. Learn more about the capabilities of Azure Defender for open-source relational databases at https://aka.ms/AzDforOpenSourceDBsDocu. Important: Enabling this plan will result in charges for protecting your open-source relational databases. Learn about the pricing on Security Center's pricing page: https://aka.ms/pricing-security-center

definitions.name: 0aa61e00-0a01-4a3c-9945-e93cffedf0e6
definitions.display_name: Azure Container Instance container group should use customer-managed key for encryption
definitions.description: Secure your containers with greater flexibility using customer-managed keys. When you specify a customer-managed key, that key is used to protect and control access to the key that encrypts your data. Using customer-managed keys provides additional capabilities to control rotation of the key encryption key or cryptographically erase data.

definitions.name: 0b60c0b2-2dc2-4e1c-b5c9-abbed971de53
definitions.display_name: Key vaults should have deletion protection enabled
definitions.description: Malicious deletion of a key vault can lead to permanent data loss. You can prevent permanent data loss by enabling purge protection and soft delete. Purge protection protects you from insider attacks by enforcing a mandatory retention period for soft deleted key vaults. No one inside your organization or Microsoft will be able to purge your key vaults during the soft delete retention period. Keep in mind that key vaults created after September 1st 2019 have soft-delete enabled by default.

Flow log helps to identify unknown or undesired traffic, verify network isolation and compliance with enterprise access rules, analyze network flows from compromised IPs and network interfaces.

networkWatcherName.description: The name of the network watcher under which the flowLog resources will be created. Make sure it belongs to the same region as the NSG.

networkWatcherRG.description: The name of the resource group where the flowLog resources will be created. This will be used only if a deployment is required. This is the resource group where the Network Watchers are located.

nsgRegion.description: This Policy will review NSGs only in the selected region. You can create other assignments to include other regions.

storageId.description: A string with the storage id for the flowlogs to be sent to. It will be used for deployment purposes only. Make sure this storage account is located in the same region as the NSG. The format must be: '/subscriptions/{subscription id}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroup name}/providers/Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/{storage account name}

definitions.description: Enable logs for Azure AI services resources. This enables you to recreate activity trails for investigation purposes, when a security incident occurs or your network is compromised

definitions.name: 1b5ef780-c53c-4a64-87f3-bb9c8c8094ba
definitions.display_name: App Service apps should disable public network access
definitions.description: Disabling public network access improves security by ensuring that the App Service is not exposed on the public internet. Creating private endpoints can limit exposure of an App Service. Learn more at: https://aka.ms/app-service-private-endpoint.

definitions.name: 1b708b0a-3380-40e9-8b79-821f9fa224cc
definitions.display_name: Disable Command Invoke on Azure Kubernetes Service clusters
definitions.description: Disabling command invoke can enhance the security by rejecting invoke-command access to the cluster

definitions.name: 1b7aa243-30e4-4c9e-bca8-d0d3022b634a
definitions.display_name: Vulnerability assessment should be enabled on SQL Managed Instance
definitions.description: Audit each SQL Managed Instance which doesn't have vulnerability assessment properly configured. Vulnerability assessment can discover, track, and help you remediate potential database vulnerabilities.

definitions.name: 1b8a7ec3-11cc-a2d3-8cd0-eedf074424a4
definitions.display_name: Employ automatic shutdown/restart when violations are detected
definitions.description: CMA_C1715 - Employ automatic shutdown/restart when violations are detected

definitions.name: 1b8c0040-b224-4ea1-be6a-47254dd5a207
definitions.display_name: Configure Azure Defender for Servers to be enabled (with 'P1' subplan) for all resources (resource level)
definitions.description: Azure Defender for Servers provides real-time threat protection for server workloads and generates hardening recommendations as well as alerts about suspicious activities. This policy will enable the Defender for Servers plan (with 'P1' subplan) for all resources (VMs and ARC Machines) in the selected scope (subscription or resource group).

definitions.name: 1b8ca024-1d5c-4dec-8995-b1a932b41780
definitions.display_name: Public network access on Azure SQL Database should be disabled
definitions.description: Disabling the public network access property improves security by ensuring your Azure SQL Database can only be accessed from a private endpoint. This configuration denies all logins that match IP or virtual network based firewall rules.

definitions.name: 1b9c0b58-fc7b-42c8-8010-cdfa1d1b8544
definitions.display_name: Configure Azure Web PubSub Service with private endpoints
definitions.description: Private endpoints connect your virtual networks to Azure services without a public IP address at the source or destination. By mapping private endpoints to Azure Web PubSub service, you can reduce data leakage risks. Learn more about private links at: https://aka.ms/awps/privatelink.

privateEndpointSubnetId.description: A subnet with private endpoint network policies disabled.

definitions.name: 1bc02227-0cb6-4e11-8f53-eb0b22eab7e8
definitions.display_name: Application Insights components should block log ingestion and querying from public networks
definitions.description: Improve Application Insights security by blocking log ingestion and querying from public networks. Only private-link connected networks will be able to ingest and query logs of this component. Learn more at https://aka.ms/AzMonPrivateLink#configure-application-insights.

definitions.name: 1bc7fd64-291f-028e-4ed6-6e07886e163f
definitions.display_name: Employ least privilege access
definitions.description: CMA_0212 - Employ least privilege access

definitions.name: 1bd3a451-9f38-43e5-aed3-bede117c3055
definitions.display_name: Enable logging by category group for Data Lake Analytics (microsoft.datalakeanalytics/accounts) to Storage
definitions.description: Resource logs should be enabled to track activities and events that take place on your resources and give you visibility and insights into any changes that occur. This policy deploys a diagnostic setting using a category group to route logs to a Storage Account for Data Lake Analytics (microsoft.datalakeanalytics/accounts).

resourceLocation.description: Resource Location must be in the same location as the Storage Account.

storageAccount.description: Full path (resourceId) to the storage account.

definitions.name: 1bd91eae-4429-4f23-b780-8c9622e023e3
definitions.display_name: Enable logging by category group for Azure AD Domain Services (microsoft.aad/domainservices) to Log Analytics
definitions.description: Resource logs should be enabled to track activities and events that take place on your resources and give you visibility and insights into any changes that occur. This policy deploys a diagnostic setting using a category group to route logs to a Log Analytics workspace for Azure AD Domain Services (microsoft.aad/domainservices).

definitions.name: 1beb1269-62ee-32cd-21ad-43d6c9750eb6
definitions.display_name: Ensure privacy program information is publicly available
definitions.description: CMA_C1867 - Ensure privacy program information is publicly available

definitions.name: 1bf67da8-b100-45bf-b89d-e4669fc54411
definitions.display_name: [Preview]: Azure Cache for Redis should be Zone Redundant
definitions.description: Azure Cache for Redis can be configured to be Zone Redundant or not. Azure Cache for Redis instances with fewer than 2 entries in their zones array or zonalAllocationPolicy is set to 'NoZones' or the sku is 'Basic' are not Zone Redundant. This policy identifies Azure Cache for Redis instances lacking the redundancy needed to withstand a zone outage.

definitions.name: 1c06e275-d63d-4540-b761-71f364c2111d
definitions.display_name: Azure Service Bus namespaces should use private link
definitions.description: Azure Private Link lets you connect your virtual network to Azure services without a public IP address at the source or destination. The Private Link platform handles the connectivity between the consumer and services over the Azure backbone network. By mapping private endpoints to Service Bus namespaces, data leakage risks are reduced. Learn more at: https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/service-bus-messaging/private-link-service.

definitions.name: 1c258345-5cd4-30c8-9ef3-5ee4dd5231d6
definitions.display_name: Develop security assessment plan
definitions.description: CMA_C1144 - Develop security assessment plan

definitions.name: 1c30f9cd-b84c-49cc-aa2c-9288447cc3b3
definitions.display_name: [Preview]: vTPM should be enabled on supported virtual machines
definitions.description: Enable virtual TPM device on supported virtual machines to facilitate Measured Boot and other OS security features that require a TPM. Once enabled, vTPM can be used to attest boot integrity. This assessment only applies to trusted launch enabled virtual machines.

definitions.name: 1c46fa74-ad5c-46e4-9cf3-6bf88e3adcba
definitions.display_name: Create regional Storage Account for VNet Flowlogs in resourceGroupName RG
definitions.description: Creates a regional Storage Account in the assigned Scope and under resource group nwtarg-<subscriptionID> by default for VNet flowlogs.

location.description: Location where the Storage Account exists or will be created in. It should match the location of the Virtual Network where flowlog is to be enabled.

definitions.name: 1c5187ed-9863-4961-bb92-c72bc3883e24
definitions.display_name: Enable logging by category group for Azure Load Testing (microsoft.loadtestservice/loadtests) to Storage
definitions.description: Resource logs should be enabled to track activities and events that take place on your resources and give you visibility and insights into any changes that occur. This policy deploys a diagnostic setting using a category group to route logs to a Storage Account for Azure Load Testing (microsoft.loadtestservice/loadtests).

resourceLocation.description: Resource Location must be in the same location as the Storage Account.

storageAccount.description: Full path (resourceId) to the storage account.

definitions.name: 1c6e92c9-99f0-4e55-9cf2-0c234dc48f99
definitions.display_name: Kubernetes clusters should not allow container privilege escalation
definitions.description: Do not allow containers to run with privilege escalation to root in a Kubernetes cluster. This recommendation is part of CIS 5.2.5 which is intended to improve the security of your Kubernetes environments. This policy is generally available for Kubernetes Service (AKS), and preview for Azure Arc enabled Kubernetes. For more information, see https://aka.ms/kubepolicydoc.

definitions.name: 1c8144d9-746a-4501-b08c-093c8d29ad04
definitions.display_name: Configure Azure Event Grid topics to disable local authentication
definitions.description: Disable local authentication methods so that your Azure Event Grid topics exclusively require Azure Active Directory identities for authentication. Learn more at: https://aka.ms/aeg-disablelocalauth.

definitions.name: 1c988dd6-ade4-430f-a608-2a3e5b0a6d38
definitions.display_name: Microsoft Defender for Containers should be enabled
definitions.description: Microsoft Defender for Containers provides hardening, vulnerability assessment and run-time protections for your Azure, hybrid, and multi-cloud Kubernetes environments.

definitions.name: 1cb4d9c2-f88f-4069-bee0-dba239a57b09
definitions.display_name: [Preview]: Guest Attestation extension should be installed on supported Windows virtual machines
definitions.description: Install Guest Attestation extension on supported virtual machines to allow Azure Security Center to proactively attest and monitor the boot integrity. Once installed, boot integrity will be attested via Remote Attestation. This assessment applies to Trusted Launch and Confidential Windows virtual machines.

definitions.name: 1cb7bf71-841c-4741-438a-67c65fdd7194
definitions.display_name: Provide security training for new users
definitions.description: CMA_0419 - Provide security training for new users

definitions.name: 1cd30d13-d34c-4cb8-8f9d-4692f7d40d97
definitions.display_name: Enable logging by category group for Chaos Experiments (microsoft.chaos/experiments) to Storage
definitions.description: Resource logs should be enabled to track activities and events that take place on your resources and give you visibility and insights into any changes that occur. This policy deploys a diagnostic setting using a category group to route logs to a Storage Account for Chaos Experiments (microsoft.chaos/experiments).

resourceLocation.description: Resource Location must be in the same location as the Storage Account.

storageAccount.description: Full path (resourceId) to the storage account.

definitions.name: 1cf164be-6819-4a50-b8fa-4bcaa4f98fb6
definitions.display_name: Public network access on Azure Data Factory should be disabled
definitions.description: Disabling the public network access property improves security by ensuring your Azure Data Factory can only be accessed from a private endpoint.

definitions.name: 1d14b021-1bae-4f93-b36b-69695e14984a
definitions.display_name: Disconnections should be logged for PostgreSQL flexible servers
definitions.description: This policy helps audit any PostgreSQL flexible servers in your environment without log_disconnections enabled.

definitions.name: 1d1e7723-ab70-4ce1-a12e-bf6977859d06
definitions.display_name: Do not allow delete on App network configuration
definitions.description: This policy applies exclusively to Mission Platform products and services; usage outside of these scopes is not supported. Deny Deleting of Network Configuration of Apps.

definitions.name: 1d320205-c6a1-4ac6-873d-46224024e8e2
definitions.display_name: Azure File Sync should use private link
definitions.description: Creating a private endpoint for the indicated Storage Sync Service resource allows you to address your Storage Sync Service resource from within the private IP address space of your organization's network, rather than through the internet-accessible public endpoint. Creating a private endpoint by itself does not disable the public endpoint.

definitions.name: 1d39b5d9-0392-8954-8359-575ce1957d1a
definitions.display_name: Support personal verification credentials issued by legal authorities
definitions.description: CMA_0507 - Support personal verification credentials issued by legal authorities

definitions.name: 1d413020-63de-11ea-bc55-0242ac130003
definitions.display_name: [Preview]: Configure log filter expressions and datastore to be used for full logs for specified Azure Machine Learning computes
definitions.description: Provide log filter expression and datastore to be used for full logs in specified Azure Machine Learning computes and can be assigned at the workspace. For more information, visit https://aka.ms/amlpolicydoc.

datastore.description: Datastore used to store filtered logs. Ex. LogsDatastore which is configured in AML.

definitions.name: 1d478a74-21ba-4b9f-9d8f-8e6fced0eec5
definitions.display_name: [Preview]: Azure Key Vault Managed HSM keys should have an expiration date
definitions.description: To use this policy in preview, you must first follow these instructions at https://aka.ms/mhsmgovernance. Cryptographic keys should have a defined expiration date and not be permanent. Keys that are valid forever provide a potential attacker with more time to compromise the key. It is a recommended security practice to set expiration dates on cryptographic keys.

definitions.name: 1d61c4d2-aef2-432b-87fc-7f96b019b7e1
definitions.display_name: Configure Kubernetes clusters with specified GitOps configuration using no secrets
definitions.description: Deploy a 'sourceControlConfiguration' to Kubernetes clusters to assure that the clusters get their source of truth for workloads and configurations from the defined git repo. This definition requires no secrets. For instructions, visit https://aka.ms/K8sGitOpsPolicy.

configurationResourceName.description: The name for the sourceControlConfiguration.  Learn more about setting up GitOps configuration: https://aka.ms/AzureArcK8sUsingGitOps.

operatorInstanceName.description: Name used in the operator instances. Maximum of 23 lowercase alphanumeric characters or hyphen. Must start and end with an alphanumeric character.

operatorNamespace.description: Namespace within which the operators will be installed. Maximum of 23 lowercase alphanumeric characters or hyphen. Must start and end with an alphanumeric character.

repositoryUrl.description: The URL for the source control repository. Learn more about URL formats: https://aka.ms/GitOpsRepoUrlParameters

definitions.name: 1d84d5fb-01f6-4d12-ba4f-4a26081d403d
definitions.display_name: Virtual machines should be migrated to new Azure Resource Manager resources
definitions.description: Use new Azure Resource Manager for your virtual machines to provide security enhancements such as: stronger access control (RBAC), better auditing, Azure Resource Manager based deployment and governance, access to managed identities, access to key vault for secrets, Azure AD-based authentication and support for tags and resource groups for easier security management

definitions.name: 1d98c506-1460-4424-9006-84210fa5214a

definitions.display_name: Conduct risk assessment and document its results
definitions.description: CMA_C1542 - Conduct risk assessment and document its results

definitions.name: 1dc2fc00-2245-4143-99f4-874c937f13ef
definitions.display_name: Azure API Management platform version should be stv2
definitions.description: Azure API Management stv1 compute platform version will be retired effective 31 August 2024, and these instances should be migrated to stv2 compute platform for continued support. Learn more at https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/api-management/breaking-changes/stv1-platform-retirement-august-2024

definitions.name: 1ddac26b-ed48-4c30-8cc5-3a68c79b8001
definitions.display_name: Kubernetes clusters should not allow endpoint edit permissions of ClusterRole/system:aggregate-to-edit
definitions.description: ClusterRole/system:aggregate-to-edit should not allow endpoint edit permissions due to CVE-2021-25740, Endpoint & EndpointSlice permissions allow cross-Namespace forwarding, https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/103675. This policy is generally available for Kubernetes Service (AKS), and preview for Azure Arc enabled Kubernetes. For more information, see https://aka.ms/kubepolicydoc.

definitions.name: 1e0d5ba8-a433-01aa-829c-86b06c9631ec
definitions.display_name: Include dynamic reconfig of customer deployed resources
definitions.description: CMA_C1364 - Include dynamic reconfig of customer deployed resources

definitions.name: 1e30110a-5ceb-460c-a204-c1c3969c6d62
definitions.display_name: Require a tag and its value on resources
definitions.description: Enforces a required tag and its value. Does not apply to resource groups.

tagName.description: Name of the tag, such as 'environment'

tagValue.description: Value of the tag, such as 'production'

definitions.name: 1e5ed725-f16c-478b-bd4b-7bfa2f7940b9
definitions.display_name: Configure Azure Synapse workspaces to use private DNS zones
definitions.description: Use private DNS zones to override the DNS resolution for a private endpoint. A private DNS zone links to your virtual network to resolve to Azure Synapse workspace. Learn more at: https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/synapse-analytics/security/how-to-connect-to-workspace-from-restricted-network#appendix-dns-registration-for-private-endpoint.

privateDnsZoneId.description: A private DNS zone Id

definitions.name: 1e66c121-a66a-4b1f-9b83-0fd99bf0fc2d
definitions.display_name: Key vaults should have soft delete enabled
definitions.description: Deleting a key vault without soft delete enabled permanently deletes all secrets, keys, and certificates stored in the key vault. Accidental deletion of a key vault can lead to permanent data loss. Soft delete allows you to recover an accidentally deleted key vault for a configurable retention period.

definitions.display_name: Review development process, standards and tools
definitions.description: CMA_C1610 - Review development process, standards and tools

definitions.display_name: [Preview]: Deploy Microsoft Defender for Endpoint agent on Windows virtual machines
definitions.description: Deploys Microsoft Defender for Endpoint on applicable Windows VM images.

definitions.display_name: Adhere to retention periods defined

definitions.display_name: Use system clocks for audit records

definitions.name: 1ee56206-5dd1-42ab-b02d-8aae8b1634ce
definitions.display_name: Azure API for FHIR should use private link
definitions.description: Azure API for FHIR should have at least one approved private endpoint connection. Clients in a virtual network can securely access resources that have private endpoint connections through private links. For more information, visit: https://aka.ms/fhir-privatelink.

definitions.name: 1f01f1c7-539c-49b5-9ef4-d4ffa37d22e0
definitions.display_name: Configure Function apps to use the latest TLS version
definitions.description: Periodically, newer versions are released for TLS either due to security flaws, include additional functionality, and enhance speed. Upgrade to the latest TLS version for Function apps to take advantage of security fixes, if any, and/or new functionalities of the latest version.

definitions.name: 1f314764-cb73-4fc9-b863-8eca98ac36e9
definitions.display_name: An Azure Active Directory administrator should be provisioned for SQL servers
definitions.description: Audit provisioning of an Azure Active Directory administrator for your SQL server to enable Azure AD authentication. Azure AD authentication enables simplified permission management and centralized identity management of database users and other Microsoft services

definitions.name: 1f68a601-6e6d-4e42-babf-3f643a047ea2
definitions.display_name: Azure Monitor Logs clusters should be encrypted with customer-managed key
definitions.description: Create Azure Monitor logs cluster with customer-managed keys encryption. By default, the log data is encrypted with service-managed keys, but customer-managed keys are commonly required to meet regulatory compliance. Customer-managed key in Azure Monitor gives you more control over the access to you data, see https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/platform/customer-managed-keys.

definitions.name: 1f6e93e8-6b31-41b1-83f6-36e449a42579
definitions.display_name: Deploy Diagnostic Settings for Event Hub to Log Analytics workspace
definitions.description: Deploys the diagnostic settings for Event Hub to stream to a regional Log Analytics workspace when any Event Hub which is missing this diagnostic settings is created or updated.

logAnalytics.description: Select Log Analytics workspace from dropdown list. If this workspace is outside of the scope of the assignment you must manually grant 'Log Analytics Contributor' permissions (or similar) to the policy assignment's principal ID.

definitions.name: 1f725891-01c0-420a-9059-4fa46cb770b7
definitions.display_name: Configure Microsoft Defender for Key Vault plan
definitions.description: Microsoft Defender for Key Vault provides an additional layer of protection and security intelligence by detecting unusual and potentially harmful attempts to access or exploit key vault accounts.

definitions.name: 1f905d99-2ab7-462c-a6b0-f709acca6c8f
definitions.display_name: Azure Cosmos DB accounts should use customer-managed keys to encrypt data at rest
definitions.description: Use customer-managed keys to manage the encryption at rest of your Azure Cosmos DB. By default, the data is encrypted at rest with service-managed keys, but customer-managed keys are commonly required to meet regulatory compliance standards. Customer-managed keys enable the data to be encrypted with an Azure Key Vault key created and owned by you. You have full control and responsibility for the key lifecycle, including rotation and management. Learn more at https://aka.ms/cosmosdb-cmk.

definitions.name: 1f90fc71-a595-4066-8974-d4d0802e8ef0
definitions.display_name: Microsoft Defender CSPM should be enabled
definitions.description: Defender Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) provides enhanced posture capabilities and a new intelligent cloud security graph to help identify, prioritize, and reduce risk. Defender CSPM is available in addition to the free foundational security posture capabilities turned on by default in Defender for Cloud.

definitions.name: 1fafeaf6-7927-4059-a50a-8eb2a7a6f2b5
definitions.display_name: Logic Apps Integration Service Environment should be encrypted with customer-managed keys
definitions.description: Deploy into Integration Service Environment to manage encryption at rest of Logic Apps data using customer-managed keys. By default, customer data is encrypted with service-managed keys, but customer-managed keys are commonly required to meet regulatory compliance standards. Customer-managed keys enable the data to be encrypted with an Azure Key Vault key created and owned by you. You have full control and responsibility for the key lifecycle, including rotation and management.

definitions.display_name: Manage nonlocal maintenance and diagnostic activities

definitions.name: 1fd32ebd-e4c3-4e13-a54a-d7422d4d95f6
definitions.display_name: Azure HDInsight clusters should use encryption at host to encrypt data at rest
definitions.description: Enabling encryption at host helps protect and safeguard your data to meet your organizational security and compliance commitments. When you enable encryption at host, data stored on the VM host is encrypted at rest and flows encrypted to the Storage service.

definitions.name: 1fd3b2cc-9904-40fa-b8da-050c02612da9
definitions.display_name: Azure Key Vault Managed HSM keys should be the specified cryptographic type
definitions.description: Some applications require the use of keys backed by a specific cryptographic type. Enforce a particular cryptographic key type, in your environment.

definitions.name: 21a8cd35-125e-4d13-b82d-2e19b7208bb7
definitions.display_name: Public network access should be disabled for Azure File Sync
definitions.description: Disabling the public endpoint allows you to restrict access to your Storage Sync Service resource to requests destined to approved private endpoints on your organization's network. definitions.description: Setting TLS version to 1.2 or newer improves security by ensuring your Azure SQL Database can only be accessed from clients using TLS 1.2 or newer. Using versions of TLS less than 1.2 is not recommended since they have well documented security vulnerabilities.

definitions.description: Injecting Function Apps in a virtual network unlocks advanced networking and security features and provides you with greater control over your network security configuration. Learn more at: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/app-service/web-sites-integrate-with-vnet.

definitions.name: 3e9965dc-cc13-47ca-8259-a4252fd0cf7b
definitions.display_name: Configure virtual network to enable Flow Log and Traffic Analytics
definitions.description: Traffic analytics and Flow logs can be enabled for all virtual networks hosted in a particular region with the settings provided during policy creation. This policy does not overwrite current setting for virtual networks that already have these feature enabled. Traffic analytics is a cloud-based solution that provides visibility into user and application activity in cloud networks.

networkWatcherName.description: The resource id of the network watcher under which the flowLog resources will be created. Make sure it belongs to the same region as the Vnet.

storageId.description: The resource id of storage account where flowlogs will be sent to. It will be used for deployment purposes only. Make sure this storage account is located in the same region as the Vnet.

vnetRegion.description: Configures for virtual network in the selected region only.

definitions.name: 3eabed6d-1912-2d3c-858b-f438d08d0412
definitions.display_name: Ensure external providers consistently meet interests of the customers
definitions.description: CMA_C1592 - Ensure external providers consistently meet interests of the customers

This policy deploys a diagnostic setting using a category group to route logs to an Event Hub for Azure Database for MySQL servers (microsoft.dbformysql/servers).

eventHubAuthorizationRuleId.description: Event Hub Authorization Rule Id - the authorization rule needs to be at Event Hub namespace level. e.g. /subscriptions/{subscription Id}/resourceGroups/{resource group}/providers/Microsoft.EventHub/namespaces/{Event Hub namespace}/authorizationrules/{authorization rule}

definitions.name: 3f84c9b0-8b64-4208-98d4-6ada96bb49c3
definitions.display_name: Azure Firewall Policy should have DNS Proxy Enabled
definitions.description: Enabling DNS Proxy will make the Azure Firewall associated with this policy to listen on port 53 and forward the DNS requests to specified DNS server

definitions.name: 3fc4dc25-5baf-40d8-9b05-7fe74c1bc64e
definitions.display_name: Kubernetes clusters should use internal load balancers
definitions.description: Use internal load balancers to make a Kubernetes service accessible only to applications running in the same virtual network as the Kubernetes cluster. For more information, see https://aka.ms/kubepolicydoc.

definitions.name: 3ff60f98-7fa4-410a-9f7f-0b00f5afdbdd
definitions.display_name: Windows machines should meet requirements for 'Security Options - Network Access'
definitions.description: Windows machines should have the specified Group Policy settings in the category 'Security Options - Network Access' for including access for anonymous users, local accounts, and remote access to the registry. This policy requires that the Guest Configuration prerequisites have been deployed to the policy assignment scope. For details, visit https://aka.ms/gcpol.

definitions.name: 4002015b-1272-4dfb-8943-fed4aeec39b6
definitions.display_name: Configure Azure Arc-enabled Kubernetes clusters to use an Azure Arc Private Link Scope
definitions.description: Azure Private Link lets you connect your virtual networks to Azure services without a public IP address at the source or destination. The Private Link platform handles the connectivity between the consumer and services over the Azure backbone network. By mapping Azure Arc-enabled servers to an Azure Arc Private Link Scope that is configured with a private endpoint, data leakage risks are reduced. Learn more about private links at: https://aka.ms/arc/privatelink.

privateLinkScopeId.description: The Azure Arc Private Link Scope to associate with the Azure Arc-enabled kubernetes cluster.

definitions.name: 4012c2b7-4e0e-a7ab-1688-4aab43f14420
definitions.display_name: Map authenticated identities to individuals
definitions.description: CMA_0372 - Map authenticated identities to individuals

definitions.name: 404c3081-a854-4457-ae30-26a93ef643f9
definitions.display_name: Secure transfer to storage accounts should be enabled
definitions.description: Audit requirement of Secure transfer in your storage account. Secure transfer is an option that forces your storage account to accept requests only from secure connections (HTTPS). Use of HTTPS ensures authentication between the server and the service and protects data in transit from network layer attacks such as man-in-the-middle, eavesdropping, and session-hijacking

definitions.name: 405c5871-3e91-4644-8a63-58e19d68ff5b
definitions.display_name: Azure Key Vault should disable public network access
definitions.description: Disable public network access for your key vault so that it's not accessible over the public internet. This can reduce data leakage risks. Learn more at: https://aka.ms/akvprivatelink.

definitions.name: 40654dcd-0b26-49d6-aeaf-d12d7c1e8c4d
definitions.display_name: Enable logging by category group for SQL managed instances (microsoft.sql/managedinstances) to Storage
definitions.description: Resource logs should be enabled to track activities and events that take place on your resources and give you visibility and insights into any changes that occur. This policy deploys a diagnostic setting using a category group to route logs to a Storage Account for SQL managed instances (microsoft.sql/managedinstances).

resourceLocation.description: Resource Location must be in the same location as the Storage Account.

storageAccount.description: Full path (resourceId) to the storage account.

definitions.name: 408934a8-941a-4c1e-ba88-dd035d9688f4
definitions.display_name: [Preview]: Azure Cache for Redis Enterprise & Flash should be Zone Redundant
definitions.description: Azure Cache for Redis Enterprise & Flash can be configured to be Zone Redundant or not. Azure Cache for Redis Enterprise & Flash instances with fewer than 3 entries in their zones array are not Zone Redundant. This policy identifies Azure Cache for Redis Enterprise & Flash instances lacking the redundancy needed to withstand a zone outage.

definitions.name: 40ce1496-89c2-40cf-80e5-3c4687d2ee4b
definitions.display_name: Enable logging by category group for Virtual networks (microsoft.network/virtualnetworks) to Event Hub
definitions.description: Resource logs should be enabled to track activities and events that take place on your resources and give you visibility and insights into any changes that occur. This policy deploys a diagnostic setting using a category group to route logs to an Event Hub for Virtual networks (microsoft.network/virtualnetworks).

eventHubAuthorizationRuleId.description: Event Hub Authorization Rule Id - the authorization rule needs to be at Event Hub namespace level. e.g. /subscriptions/{subscription Id}/resourceGroups/{resource group}/providers/Microsoft.EventHub/namespaces/{Event Hub namespace}/authorizationrules/{authorization rule}

resourceLocation.description: Resource Location must be in the same location as the Event Hub Namespace.

definitions.name: 40d17f6f-a9d2-4f1d-8c37-a699a5372a87
definitions.display_name: [Preview]: Virtual Machine Scale Sets with more than 2 availability zones should have automatic AZ rebalancing enabled
definitions.description: This policy enables automatic AZ rebalancing for Virtual Machine Scale Sets that are otherwise zone resilient. Automatic zone rebalancing helps to ensure that your Virtual Machine Scale Sets are evenly distributed across the zones in the region.

definitions.name: 40df99da-1232-49b1-a39a-6da8d878f469
definitions.display_name: Inherit a tag from the subscription if missing
definitions.description: Adds the specified tag with its value from the containing subscription when any resource missing this tag is created or updated. Existing resources can be remediated by triggering a remediation task. If the tag exists with a different value it will not be changed.

tagName.description: Name of the tag, such as 'environment'

definitions.name: 40e85574-ef33-47e8-a854-7a65c7500560
definitions.display_name: Azure MySQL flexible server should have Microsoft Entra Only Authentication enabled
definitions.description: Disabling local authentication methods and allowing only Microsoft Entra Authentication improves security by ensuring that Azure MySQL flexible server can exclusively be accessed by Microsoft Entra identities.

definitions.name: 40f0d036-d73d-45a9-8c3d-f3f84d227193
definitions.display_name: Enable logging by category group for Batch accounts (microsoft.batch/batchaccounts) to Storage
definitions.description: Resource logs should be enabled to track activities and events that take place on your resources and give you visibility and insights into any changes that occur. This policy deploys a diagnostic setting using a category group to route logs to a Storage Account for Batch accounts (microsoft.batch/batchaccounts).

resourceLocation.description: Resource Location must be in the same location as the Storage Account.

storageAccount.description: Full path (resourceId) to the storage account.

definitions.name: 40f1aee2-4db4-4b74-acb1-c6972e24cca8
definitions.display_name: Configure Node OS Auto upgrade on Azure Kubernetes Cluster
definitions.description: Use Node OS auto-upgrade to control node-level OS security updates of Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters. For more info, visit https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/aks/auto-upgrade-node-image.

definitions.name: 41172402-8d73-64c7-0921-909083c086b0
definitions.display_name: Not allow for information systems to accompany with individuals
definitions.description: CMA_C1182 - Not allow for information systems to accompany with individuals

definitions.name: 41388f1c-2db0-4c25-95b2-35d7f5ccbfa9
definitions.display_name: Azure Monitor should collect activity logs from all regions
definitions.description: This policy audits the Azure Monitor log profile which does not export activities from all Azure supported regions including global.

definitions.name: 413923f0-ff16-41ae-8583-90c5c5d9fa8f
definitions.display_name: Customer managed key encryption must be used as part of CMK Encryption for Arc SQL managed instances.
definitions.description: As a part of CMK encryption, Customer managed key encryption must be used. Learn more at https://aka.ms/EnableTDEArcSQLMI.

definitions.name: 41425d9f-d1a5-499a-9932-f8ed8453932c
definitions.display_name: Temp disks and cache for agent node pools in Azure Kubernetes Service clusters should be encrypted at host
definitions.description: To enhance data security, the data stored on the virtual machine (VM) host of your Azure Kubernetes Service nodes VMs should be encrypted at rest. This is a common requirement in many regulatory and industry compliance standards.

definitions.name: 415eaa04-e9db-476a-ba43-092d70ebe1e7
definitions.display_name: Enable logging by category group for Bot Services (microsoft.botservice/botservices) to Log Analytics
definitions.description: Resource logs should be enabled to track activities and events that take place on your resources and give you visibility and insights into any changes that occur. This policy deploys a diagnostic setting using a category group to route logs to a Log Analytics workspace for Bot Services (microsoft.botservice/botservices).

definitions.name: 41a72361-06e3-4e80-832a-690bd0708bc1
definitions.display_name: Configure Storage Accounts to restrict network access through network ACL bypass configuration only.
definitions.description: To improve the security of Storage Accounts, enable access only through network ACL bypass. This policy should be used in combination with a private endpoint for storage account access.

definitions.name: 41c4164d-a848-48d3-b10f-c3076787f0f5
definitions.display_name: App Service app slots should enable configuration routing to Azure Virtual Network.
definitions.description: This policy applies exclusively to Mission Platform products and services; usage outside of these scopes is not supported. App Service app slots should enable configuration routing to Azure Virtual Network.

definitions.name: 41ebf9df-66cb-48e9-a8d0-98afb4e150ce
definitions.display_name: Configure diagnostic settings for container groups to Log Analytics workspace
definitions.description: Deploys the diagnostic settings for Container Instance to stream resource logs to a Log Analytics workspace when any container instance which is missing this diagnostic settings is created or updated.

logAnalytics.description: Select Log Analytics workspace from dropdown list. If this workspace is outside of the scope of the assignment you must manually grant 'Log Analytics Contributor' permissions (or similar) to the policy assignment's principal ID.

definitions.name: 42116f15-5665-a52a-87bb-b40e64c74b6c
definitions.display_name: Develop acceptable use policies and procedures
definitions.description: CMA_0143 - Develop acceptable use policies and procedures

definitions.name: 4221adbc-5c0f-474f-88b7-037a99e6114c
definitions.display_name: Audit Windows VMs with a pending reboot
definitions.description: Requires that prerequisites are deployed to the policy assignment scope. For details, visit https://aka.ms/gcpol. Machines are non-compliant if the machine is pending reboot for any of the following reasons: component based servicing, Windows Update, pending file rename, pending computer rename, configuration manager pending reboot. Each detection has a unique registry path.

definitions.name: 423dd1ba-798e-40e4-9c4d-b6902674b423
definitions.display_name: Kubernetes clusters should disable automounting API credentials
definitions.description: Disable automounting API credentials to prevent a potentially compromised Pod resource to run API commands against Kubernetes clusters. For more information, see https://aka.ms/kubepolicydoc.

definitions.name: 423f6d9c-0c73-9cc6-64f4-b52242490368
definitions.display_name: Develop security safeguards
definitions.description: CMA_0161 - Develop security safeguards

definitions.name: 425bea59-a659-4cbb-8d31-34499bd030b8
definitions.display_name: Web Application Firewall (WAF) should use the specified mode for Azure Front Door Service
definitions.description: Mandates the use of 'Detection' or 'Prevention' mode to be active on all Web Application Firewall policies for Azure Front Door Service.

definitions.name: 426c172c-9914-10d1-25dd-669641fc1af4
definitions.display_name: Enable detection of network devices
definitions.description: CMA_0220 - Enable detection of network devices

definitions.name: 42781ec6-6127-4c30-bdfa-fb423a0047d3
definitions.display_name: Container registries should have ARM audience token authentication disabled.
definitions.description: Disable Azure Active Directory ARM audience tokens for authentication to your registry. Only Azure Container Registry (ACR) audience tokens will be used for authentication. This will ensure only tokens meant for usage on the registry can be used for authentication. Disabling ARM audience tokens does not affect admin user's or scoped access tokens' authentication. Learn more at: https://aka.ms/acr/authentication.

definitions.name: 428256e6-1fac-4f48-a757-df34c2b3336d
definitions.display_name: Resource logs in Batch accounts should be enabled
definitions.description: Audit enabling of resource logs. This enables you to recreate activity trails to use for investigation purposes; when a security incident occurs or when your network is compromised

definitions.name: 42830b63-79aa-4ea5-85dc-6baa719d7d7c
definitions.display_name: [Preview]: Configure SSH security posture for Windows
definitions.description: This policy configures SSH server security configuration on Windows Server 2019, 2022, and 2025 machines (Azure VMs and Arc-enabled machines). For more information including pre-requisites, settings in scope, defaults, and customization, see https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/osconfig/overviewsshposture-control-windows.

definitions.name: 42ba1d72-e90f-42f8-bf99-5a1351eed2b1
definitions.display_name: Sets Kubernetes cluster containers CPU limits to default values in case not present.
definitions.description: Setting container CPU limits to prevent resource exhaustion attacks in a Kubernetes cluster.

definitions.name: 42daa901-5969-47ef-92cb-b75df946195a
definitions.display_name: [Preview]: Load Balancers should be Zone Resilient
definitions.description: Load Balancers with a sku other than Basic inherit the resilience of the Public IP addresses in their frontend. When combined with the 'Public IP addresses should be Zone Resilient' policy, this approach ensures the necessary redundancy to withstand a zone outage.

definitions.name: 42daa904-5969-47ef-92cb-b75df946195a
definitions.display_name: [Preview]: API Management Service should be Zone Redundant
definitions.description: API Management Service can be configured to be Zone Redundant or not. An API Management Service is Zone Redundant if its sku name is 'Premium' and it has at least two entries in it's zones array. This policy identifies API Management Services lacking the redundancy needed to withstand a zone outage.

definitions.name: 42daa904-5969-47ef-92fb-b75df946195a
definitions.display_name: [Preview]: Container App should be Zone Redundant
definitions.description: Container App can be configured to be Zone Redundant or not. A Container App is Zone Redundant if its managed environment's 'ZoneRedundant' property is set to true. This policy identifies Container App lacking the redundancy needed to withstand a zone outage.

definitions.name: 42e5ad1f-57fd-49a7-b0e4-c7a7ae25ba3d
definitions.display_name: Enable logging by category group for Code Signing Accounts (microsoft.codesigning/codesigningaccounts) to Storage
definitions.description: Resource logs should be enabled to track activities and events that take place on your resources and give you visibility and insights into any changes that occur. This policy deploys a diagnostic setting using a category group to route logs to a Storage Account for Code Signing Accounts (microsoft.codesigning/codesigningaccounts).

resourceLocation.description: Resource Location must be in the same location as the Storage Account.

storageAccount.description: Full path (resourceId) to the storage account.

definitions.name: 42f4f3a2-7d20-4c13-a05d-01857a626c22
definitions.display_name: [Preview]: Virtual Machines should be Zone Aligned
definitions.description: Virtual Machines can be configured to be Zone Aligned or not. They are considered Zone Aligned if they have only one entry in their zones array. This policy ensures that they are configured to operate within a single availability zone.

definitions.name: 433de59e-7a53-a766-02c2-f80f8421469a
definitions.display_name: Implement incident handling
definitions.description: CMA_0318 - Implement incident handling

definitions.name: 434b25a4-5396-41ec-97aa-1f4ae3bf269d
definitions.display_name: Enable logging by category group for Analysis Services (microsoft.analysisservices/servers) to Storage
definitions.description: Resource logs should be enabled to track activities and events that take place on your resources and give you visibility and insights into any changes that occur. This policy deploys a diagnostic setting using a category group to route logs to a Storage Account for Analysis Services (microsoft.analysisservices/servers).

resourceLocation.description: Resource Location must be in the same location as the Storage Account.

storageAccount.description: Full path (resourceId) to the storage account.

definitions.name: 437914ee-c176-4fff-8986-7e05eb971365
definitions.display_name: Configure Azure Monitor Private Link Scope to use private DNS zones
definitions.description: Use private DNS zones to override the DNS resolution for a private endpoint. A private DNS zone links to your virtual network to resolve to Azure Monitor private link scope. Learn more at: https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/logs/private-link-security#connect-to-a-private-endpoint.

privateDnsZoneId1.description: One of the five private DNS zone IDs required for Microsoft.Insights/privateLinkScopes to resolve a private DNS Zone to your Azure Monitor Private Link scope.

privateDnsZoneId2.description: One of the five private DNS zone IDs required for Microsoft.Insights/privateLinkScopes to resolve a private DNS Zone to your Azure Monitor Private Link scope.

privateDnsZoneId3.description: One of the five private DNS zone IDs required for Microsoft.Insights/privateLinkScopes to resolve a private DNS Zone to your Azure Monitor Private Link scope.

privateDnsZoneId4.description: One of the five private DNS zone IDs required for Microsoft.Insights/privateLinkScopes to resolve a private DNS Zone.

privateDnsZoneId5.description: One of the five private DNS zone IDs required for Microsoft.Insights/privateLinkScopes to resolve a private DNS Zone.

definitions.name: 438c38d2-3772-465a-a9cc-7a6666a275ce
definitions.display_name: Azure Machine Learning Workspaces should disable public network access
definitions.description: Disabling public network access improves security by ensuring that the Machine Learning Workspaces aren't exposed on the public internet. You can control exposure of your workspaces by creating private endpoints instead. Learn more at: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/machine-learning/how-to-configure-private-link?view=azureml-api-2&tabs=azure-portal.

definitions.name: 43ac3ccb-4ef6-7d63-9a3f-6848485ba4e8
definitions.display_name: Automate process to document implemented changes
definitions.description: CMA_C1195 - Automate process to document implemented changes

definitions.name: 43bb60fe-1d7e-4b82-9e93-496bfc99e7d5
definitions.display_name: Windows machines should meet requirements for 'System Audit Policies - Account Logon'
definitions.description: Windows machines should have the specified Group Policy settings in the category 'System Audit Policies - Account Logon' for auditing credential validation and other account logon events. This policy requires that the Guest Configuration prerequisites have been deployed to the policy assignment scope. For details, visit https://aka.ms/gcpol.

definitions.name: 43bc7be6-5e69-4b0d-a2bb-e815557ca673
definitions.display_name: Public network access on Azure Data Explorer should be disabled
definitions.description: Disabling the public network access property improves security by ensuring Azure Data Explorer can only be accessed from a private endpoint. This configuration denies all logins that match IP or virtual network based firewall rules.

definitions.name: 43c323f6-0329-4f7c-a19a-6e5a5690d042
definitions.display_name: Azure Device Update accounts should use customer-managed key to encrypt data at rest
definitions.description: Encryption of data at rest in Azure Device Update with customer-managed key adds a second layer of encryption on top of the default service-managed keys, enables customer control of keys, custom rotation policies, and ability to manage access to data through key access control. Learn more at:https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/iot-hub-device-update/device-update-data-encryption.

definitions.name: 43d6e3bd-fc6a-4b44-8b4d-2151d8736a11
definitions.display_name: Configure Azure HDInsight clusters to use private DNS zones
definitions.description: Use private DNS zones to override the DNS resolution for a private endpoint. A private DNS zone links to your virtual network to resolve to Azure HDInsight clusters. Learn more at: https://aka.ms/hdi.pl.

groupId.description: Target group id (sub resource type) for the private endpoint.

privateDnsZoneId.description: The private DNS zone name required for Azure HDInsight clusters to resolve a private DNS Zone.

definitions.name: 441af8bf-7c88-4efc-bd24-b7be28d4acce
definitions.display_name: Enable logging by category group for Event Hubs Namespaces (microsoft.eventhub/namespaces) to Log Analytics
definitions.description: Resource logs should be enabled to track activities and events that take place on your resources and give you visibility and insights into any changes that occur. This policy deploys a diagnostic setting using a category group to route logs to a Log Analytics workspace for Event Hubs Namespaces (microsoft.eventhub/namespaces).

definitions.name: 44433aa3-7ec2-4002-93ea-65c65ff0310a
definitions.display_name: Configure Azure Defender for open-source relational databases to be enabled
definitions.description: Azure Defender for open-source relational databases detects anomalous activities indicating unusual and potentially harmful attempts to access or exploit databases. Learn more about the capabilities of Azure Defender for open-source relational databases at https://aka.ms/AzDforOpenSourceDBsDocu. Important: Enabling this plan will result in charges for protecting your open-source relational databases. Learn about the pricing on Security Center's pricing page: https://aka.ms/pricing-security-center

definitions.name: 4485d24b-a9d3-4206-b691-1fad83bc5007
definitions.display_name: Configure Windows VMSS to install AMA for ChangeTracking and Inventory with user-assigned managed identity
definitions.description: Automate the deployment of Azure Monitor Agent extension on your Windows virtual machine scale sets for enabling ChangeTracking and Inventory. This policy will install the extension and configure it to use the specified user-assigned managed identity if the OS and region are supported, and skip install otherwise. Learn more: https://aka.ms/AMAOverview.

bringYourOwnUserAssignedManagedIdentity.description: If set to true, Azure Monitor Agent will use the user-assigned managed identity specified via the 'User-Assigned Managed Identity ...' parameters for authentication. Otherwise, Azure Monitor Agent will use the user-assigned managed identity /subscriptions/<subscription-id>/resourceGroups/built-in-identity-rg/providers/Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities/built-in-identity-<location> for authentication.

definitions.name: 449ebb52-945b-36e5-3446-af6f33770f8f
definitions.display_name: Update the security authorization
definitions.description: CMA_C1160 - Update the security authorization

definitions.name: 44a0b5ee-56f4-4285-a136-9e6dc3471011
definitions.display_name: Configure snapshot network access policy to deny all
definitions.description: This policy applies exclusively to Mission Platform products and services; usage outside of these scopes is not supported. Compute policy denies snapshot export from the environment.

definitions.name: 44b71aa8-099d-8b97-1557-0e853ec38e0d
definitions.display_name: Obtain functional properties of security controls
definitions.description: CMA_C1575 - Obtain functional properties of security controls

definitions.name: 44c5a1f9-7ef6-4c38-880c-273e8f7a3c24
definitions.display_name: [Preview]: Cosmos Database Accounts should be Zone Redundant
definitions.description: Cosmos Database Accounts can be configured to be Zone Redundant or not. If the 'enableMultipleWriteLocations' is set to 'true' then all locations must have a 'isZoneRedundant' property and it must be set to 'true'. If the 'enableMultipleWriteLocations' is set to 'false' then the primary location ('failoverPriority' set to 0) must have a 'isZoneRedundant' property and it must be set to 'true'. Enforcing this policy ensures Cosmos Database Accounts are appropriately configured for zone redundancy.

definitions.name: 44f8a42d-739f-8030-89a8-4c2d5b3f6af3
definitions.display_name: Provide audit review, analysis, and reporting capability
definitions.description: CMA_C1124 - Provide audit review, analysis, and reporting capability

definitions.name: 4502e506-5f35-0df4-684f-b326e3cc7093
definitions.display_name: Terminate user session automatically
definitions.description: CMA_C1054 - Terminate user session automatically

definitions.name: 450d2877-ebea-41e8-b00c-e286317d21bf
definitions.display_name: Azure Kubernetes Service Clusters should enable Microsoft Entra ID integration
definitions.description: AKS-managed Microsoft Entra ID integration can manage the access to the clusters by configuring Kubernetes role-based access control (Kubernetes RBAC) based on a user's identity or directory group membership. Learn more at: https://aka.ms/aks-managed-aad.

definitions.name: 4510daf9-5abc-4d7d-a11d-d84416b814f6
definitions.display_name: [Preview]: Azure Backup should be enabled for Blobs in Storage Accounts
definitions.description: Ensure protection of your Storage Accounts by enabling Azure Backup. Azure Backup is a secure and cost effective data protection solution for Azure.

definitions.name: 454c7d4b-c141-43f1-8c81-975ebb15a9b5
definitions.display_name: Enable logging by category group for Azure Databricks Services (microsoft.databricks/workspaces) to Log Analytics
definitions.description: Resource logs should be enabled to track activities and events that take place on your resources and give you visibility and insights into any changes that occur. This policy deploys a diagnostic setting using a category group to route logs to a Log Analytics workspace for Azure Databricks Services (microsoft.databricks/workspaces).

definitions.name: 45831138-d7ee-46ba-b674-b05e62effff7
definitions.display_name: Configure Function app slots to disable local authentication for FTP deployments
definitions.description: Disabling local authentication methods for FTP deployments improves security by ensuring that function app slots exclusively require Microsoft Entra identities for authentication. Learn more at: https://aka.ms/app-service-disable-basic-auth.

definitions.name: 4598f028-de1f-4694-8751-84dceb5f86b9
definitions.display_name: Azure Web Application Firewall on Azure Front Door should have request body inspection enabled
definitions.description: Ensure that Web Application Firewalls associated to Azure Front Doors have request body inspection enabled. This allows the WAF to inspect properties within the HTTP body that may not be evaluated in the HTTP headers, cookies, or URI.

definitions.name: 45c6bfc7-4520-4d64-a158-730cd92eedbc
definitions.display_name: Enable logging by category group for Azure Cosmos DB (microsoft.documentdb/databaseaccounts) to Log Analytics
definitions.description: Resource logs should be enabled to track activities and events that take place on your resources and give you visibility and insights into any changes that occur. This policy deploys a diagnostic setting using a category group to route logs to a Log Analytics workspace for Azure Cosmos DB (microsoft.documentdb/databaseaccounts).

definitions.name: 45e05259-1eb5-4f70-9574-baf73e9d219b
definitions.display_name: Azure Machine Learning workspaces should use private link
definitions.description: Azure Private Link lets you connect your virtual network to Azure services without a public IP address at the source or destination. The Private Link platform handles the connectivity between the consumer and services over the Azure backbone network. By mapping private endpoints to Azure Machine Learning workspaces, data leakage risks are reduced. Learn more about private links at: https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/machine-learning/how-to-configure-private-link.

definitions.name: 46238e2f-3f6f-4589-9f3f-77bed4116e67
definitions.display_name: Azure Kubernetes Clusters should use Azure CNI
definitions.description: Azure CNI is a prerequisite for some Azure Kubernetes Service features, including Azure network policies, Windows node pools and virtual nodes add-on. Learn more at: https://aka.ms/aks-azure-cni

definitions.name: 46388f67-373c-4018-98d3-2b83172dd13a
definitions.display_name: Fluid Relay should use customer-managed keys to encrypt data at rest
definitions.description: Use customer-managed keys to manage the encryption at rest of your Fluid Relay server. By default, customer data is encrypted with service-managed keys, but CMKs are commonly required to meet regulatory compliance standards. Customer-managed keys enable the data to be encrypted with an Azure Key Vault key created and owned by you, with full control and responsibility, including rotation and management. Learn more at https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/azure-fluid-relay/concepts/customer-managed-keys.

definitions.name: 464a1620-21b5-448d-8ce6-d4ac6d1bc49a
definitions.display_name: Azure SignalR Service should use a Private Link enabled SKU
definitions.description: Azure Private Link lets you connect your virtual network to Azure services without a public IP address at the source or destination which protect your resources against public data leakage risks. The policy limits you to Private Link enabled SKUs for Azure SignalR Service. Learn more about private link at: https://aka.ms/asrs/privatelink.

definitions.name: 46dad49f-8945-44d7-9bb1-2e1542f627d3
definitions.display_name: App Service app slots that use Java should use a specified 'Java version'
definitions.description: Periodically, newer versions are released for Java software either due to security flaws or to include additional functionality. Using the latest Java version for App Service apps is recommended in order to take advantage of security fixes, if any, and/or new functionalities of the latest version. This policy only applies to Linux apps. This policy requires you to specify a Java version that meets your requirements.

definitions.name: 47031206-ce96-41f8-861b-6a915f3de284
definitions.display_name: [Preview]: IoT Hub device provisioning service data should be encrypted using customer-managed keys (CMK)
definitions.description: Use customer-managed keys to manage the encryption at rest of your IoT Hub device provisioning service. The data is automatically encrypted at rest with service-managed keys, but customer-managed keys (CMK) are commonly required to meet regulatory compliance standards. CMKs enable the data to be encrypted with an Azure Key Vault key created and owned by you. Learn more about CMK encryption at https://aka.ms/dps/CMK.

definitions.name: 470baccb-7e51-4549-8b1a-3e5be069f663
definitions.display_name: Azure Cache for Redis should disable public network access
definitions.description: Disabling public network access improves security by ensuring that the Azure Cache for Redis isn't exposed on the public internet. You can limit exposure of your Azure Cache for Redis by creating private endpoints instead. Learn more at: https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/azure-cache-for-redis/cache-private-link.

definitions.name: 4733ea7b-a883-42fe-8cac-97454c2a9e4a
definitions.display_name: Storage accounts should have infrastructure encryption
definitions.description: Enable infrastructure encryption for higher level of assurance that the data is secure. When infrastructure encryption is enabled, data in a storage account is encrypted twice.

This policy is generally available for Kubernetes Service (AKS), and preview for Azure Arc enabled Kubernetes. For more information, see https://aka.ms/kubepolicydoc.

WDATP setting must be turned on for this setting to be applied. See: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/defender-for-cloud/integration-defender-for-endpoint for more information.

definitions.description: Restricts the CriticalAddonsOnly taint to just the system pool. AKS uses the CriticalAddonsOnly taint to keep customer pods away from the system pool. It ensures a clear separation between AKS components and customer pods, as well as prevents customer pods from being evicted if they do not tolerate the CriticalAddonsOnly taint.

definitions.name: 48af4db5-9b8b-401c-8e74-076be876a430
definitions.display_name: Geo-redundant backup should be enabled for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
definitions.description: Azure Database for PostgreSQL allows you to choose the redundancy option for your database server. It can be set to a geo-redundant backup storage in which the data is not only stored within the region in which your server is hosted, but is also replicated to a paired region to provide recovery option in case of a region failure. Configuring geo-redundant storage for backup is only allowed during server create.

This policy requires that the Guest Configuration prerequisites have been deployed to the policy assignment scope. For details, visit https://aka.ms/gcpol.

definitions.name: 493c215c-0553-4976-bc81-57d2c04fc8c1
definitions.display_name: [Preview]: Application Gateways should be Zone Resilient
definitions.description: Application Gateways can be configured to be either Zone Aligned, Zone Redundant, or neither. Application Gatewaysmthat havenexactly one entry in their zones array are considered Zone Aligned. In contrast, Application Gatmways withn3 or more entries in their zones array are recognized as Zone Redundant. This policy helps identify and enforce these resilience configurations.

definitions.name: 493c215d-2553-4976-bc81-57d2c04fc8c1
definitions.display_name: [Preview]: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server should be Zone Resilient
definitions.description: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server can be configured to be either Zone Aligned, Zone Redundant, or neither. PostgreSQL Server that has a standby server selected in same zone for high availability is considered Zone Aligned. In contrast, PostgreSQL Server that has a standby server selected to be in a different zone for high availability is recognized as Zone Redundant. This policy helps identify and enforce these resilience configurations.

definitions.name: 493c215d-2554-5976-bc81-57d2c04fc8c1

MySQL Server that has a standby server selected in same zone for high availability is considered Zone Aligned. In contrast, MySQL Server that has a standby server selected to be in a different zone for high availability is recognized as Zone Redundant. This policy helps identify and enforce these resilience configurations.

Enforcing this policy helps ensure that Backup Vaults are appropriately configured for zone resilience, reducing the risk of downtime during zone outages.

definitions.display_name: Audit Windows machines that do not have the maximum password age set to specified number of days
definitions.description: Requires that prerequisites are deployed to the policy assignment scope. For details, visit https://aka.ms/gcpol. Machines are non-compliant if Windows machines that do not have the maximum password age set to specified number of days. Default value for maximum password age is 70 days

definitions.name: 4d080fa5-a6d2-4f98-ba9c-f482d0d335c0
definitions.display_name: Azure Health Bots should use customer-managed keys to encrypt data at rest
definitions.description: Use customer-managed keys (CMK) to manage the encryption at rest of the data of your healthbots. By default, the data is encrypted at rest with service-managed keys, but CMK are commonly required to meet regulatory compliance standards. CMK enable the data to be encrypted with an Azure Key Vault key created and owned by you. You have full control and responsibility for the key lifecycle, including rotation and management. Learn more at https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/health-bot/cmk

definitions.name: 4d0bc837-6eff-477e-9ecd-33bf8d4212a5
definitions.display_name: Function apps should use an Azure file share for its content directory
definitions.description: The content directory of a Function app should be located on an Azure file share. The storage account information for the file share must be provided before any publishing activity. To learn more about using Azure Files for hosting app service content refer to https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2151594.

definitions.description: Enable FTPS enforcement for enhanced security.

definitions.description: Disable or PermanentlyDisable Cross Subscription Restore for your Backup vault so that restore targets cannot be in different subscription from the vault subscription. Learn more at: https://aka.ms/csrstatechange.

definitions.display_name: Azure Defender for servers should be enabled
definitions.description: Azure Defender for servers provides real-time threat protection for server workloads and generates hardening recommendations as well as alerts about suspicious activities.

definitions.description: Deploys the diagnostic settings for Data Lake Analytics to stream to a regional Event Hub when any Data Lake Analytics which is missing this diagnostic settings is created or updated.

The authorization rule needs to be at Event Hub namespace level. e.g. /subscriptions/{subscription Id}/resourceGroups/{resource group}/providers/Microsoft.EventHub/namespaces/{Event Hub namespace}/authorizationrules/{authorization rule}

definitions.display_name: Configure Batch accounts to disable local authentication
definitions.description: Disable location authentication methods so that your Batch accounts require Azure Active Directory identities exclusively for authentication. Learn more at: https://aka.ms/batch/auth.

definitions.name: 4dcfb8b5-05cd-4090-a931-2ec29057e1fc
definitions.display_name: App Service app slots should use latest 'HTTP Version'
definitions.description: Periodically, newer versions are released for HTTP either due to security flaws or to include additional functionality. Using the latest HTTP version for web apps to take advantage of security fixes, if any, and/or new functionalities of the newer version.

definitions.name: 4df26ba8-026d-45b0-9521-bffa44d741d2
definitions.display_name: Cloud Services (extended support) role instances should have system updates installed
definitions.description: Secure your Cloud Services (extended support) role instances by ensuring the latest security and critical updates are installed on them.

definitions.name: 4e6c27d5-a6ee-49cf-b2b4-d8fe90fa2b8b
definitions.display_name: Users must authenticate with multi-factor authentication to create or update resources
definitions.description: This policy definition blocks resource create and update operations when the caller is not authenticated via MFA. For more information, visit https://aka.ms/mfaforazure.

definitions.name: 4eb216f2-9dba-4979-86e6-5d7e63ce3b75
definitions.display_name: Configure Azure AI Search services to disable local authentication
definitions.description: Disable local authentication methods so that your Azure AI Search services exclusively require Azure Active Directory identities for authentication. Learn more at: https://aka.ms/azure-cognitive-search/rbac.

definitions.name: 4eb5e667-e871-4292-9c5d-8bbb94e0c908
definitions.display_name: Auditing with PgAudit should be enabled for PostgreSQL flexible servers
definitions.description: This policy helps audit any PostgreSQL flexible servers in your environment which is not enabled to use pgaudit.

definitions.name: 4eb909e7-6d64-656d-6465-2eeb297a1625
definitions.display_name: [Preview]: Deploy Microsoft Defender for Endpoint agent on Linux hybrid machines
definitions.description: Deploys Microsoft Defender for Endpoint agent on Linux hybrid machines

definitions.name: 4ec38ebc-381f-45ee-81a4-acbc4be878f8
definitions.display_name: Deploy - Configure private DNS zones for private endpoints that connect to Batch accounts
definitions.description: Private DNS records allow private connections to private endpoints. Private endpoint connections allow secure communication by enabling private connectivity to Batch accounts without a need for public IP addresses at the source or destination. For more information on private endpoints and DNS zones in Batch, see https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/batch/private-connectivity.

privateDnsZoneId.description: The private DNS zone to deploy in a new private DNS zone group and link to the private endpoint

definitions.name: 4ec52d6d-beb7-40c4-9a9e-fe753254690e
definitions.display_name: Azure data factories should be encrypted with a customer-managed key
definitions.description: Use customer-managed keys to manage the encryption at rest of your Azure Data Factory. By default, customer data is encrypted with service-managed keys, but customer-managed keys are commonly required to meet regulatory compliance standards. Customer-managed keys enable the data to be encrypted with an Azure Key Vault key created and owned by you. You have full control and responsibility for the key lifecycle, including rotation and management. Learn more at https://aka.ms/adf-cmk.

definitions.name: 4edaca8c-0912-1ac5-9eaa-6a1057740fae
definitions.display_name: Provide capability to disconnect or disable remote access
definitions.description: CMA_C1066 - Provide capability to disconnect or disable remote access

definitions.name: 4ee3ee6a-96ea-4d25-9c00-17f11d2e02c8
definitions.display_name: [Preview]: Sets Privilege escalation in the Pod spec in init containers to false.
definitions.description: Setting Privilege escalation to false in init containers increases security by preventing containers from allowing privilege escalation such as via set-user-ID or set-group-ID file mode.

definitions.display_name: App Service app slots should use the latest TLS version
definitions.description: Periodically, newer versions are released for TLS either due to security flaws, include additional functionality, and enhance speed. Upgrade to the latest TLS version for App Service apps to take advantage of security fixes, if any, and/or new functionalities of the latest version.

definitions.name: 4efbd9d8-6bc6-45f6-9be2-7fe9dd5d89ff
definitions.display_name: Configure Windows virtual machine scale sets to run Azure Monitor Agent using system-assigned managed identity
definitions.description: Automate the deployment of Azure Monitor Agent extension on your Windows virtual machine scale sets for collecting telemetry data from the guest OS. This policy will install the extension if the OS and region are supported and system-assigned managed identity is enabled, and skip install otherwise. Learn more: https://aka.ms/AMAOverview.

definitions.description: The Container Storage Interface (CSI) is a standard for exposing arbitrary block and file storage systems to containerized workloads on Kubernetes. In-tree provisioner StorageClass should be deprecated since AKS version 1.21. To learn more, https://aka.ms/aks-csi-driver

definitions.name: 4f4f78b8-e367-4b10-a341-d9a4ad5cf1c7
definitions.display_name: Subscriptions should have a contact email address for security issues
definitions.description: To ensure the relevant people in your organization are notified when there is a potential security breach in one of your subscriptions, set a security contact to receive email notifications from Security Center.

definitions.description: Resource logs should be enabled to track activities and events that take place on your resources and give you visibility and insights into any changes that occur. This policy deploys a diagnostic setting using a category group to route logs to a Log Analytics workspace for microsoft.networkcloud/storageappliances.

definitions.name: 4f9dc7db-30c1-420c-b61a-e1d640128d26

definitions.description: Adds the specified tag and value when any resource missing this tag is created or updated. Existing resources can be remediated by triggering a remediation task. If the tag exists with a different value it will not be changed. Does not modify tags on resource groups.

tagName.description: Name of the tag, such as 'environment'

tagValue.description: Value of the tag, such as 'production'

definitions.name: 4fa4b6c0-31ca-4c0d-b10d-24b96f62a751
definitions.display_name: Storage account public access should be disallowed
definitions.description: Anonymous public read access to containers and blobs in Azure Storage is a convenient way to share data but might present security risks. To prevent data breaches caused by undesired anonymous access, Microsoft recommends preventing public access to a storage account unless your scenario requires it.

definitions.name: 501541f7-f7e7-4cd6-868c-4190fdad3ac9
definitions.display_name: A vulnerability assessment solution should be enabled on your virtual machines
definitions.description: Audits virtual machines to detect whether they are running a supported vulnerability assessment solution. A core component of every cyber risk and security program is the identification and analysis of vulnerabilities. Azure Security Center's standard pricing tier includes vulnerability scanning for your virtual machines at no extra cost. Additionally, Security Center can automatically deploy this tool for you.

definitions.description: Enable automation of Microsoft Defender for Cloud regulatory compliance. This policy deploys a workflow automation with your conditions and triggers on the assigned scope. To deploy this policy on newly created subscriptions, open the Compliance tab, select the relevant non-compliant assignment and create a remediation task.

logicAppResourceId.description: The Logic App that is triggered.

logicAppTrigger.description: The trigger connector of the logic app that is triggered. Possible values: 'Manual (Incoming HTTP request)', 'When an Azure Security Center regulatory compliance assessment is created or triggered'.
allowed_values: When an Azure Security Center regulatory compliance assessment is created or triggered

resourceGroupLocation.description: The location where the resource group and the workflow automation are created.

resourceGroupName.description: The resource group name where the workflow automation is created. If you enter a name for a resource group that doesn't exist, it'll be created in the subscription.

definitions.description: This policy ensures that all Azure virtual network gateway connections use a custom Internet Protocol Security(Ipsec)/Internet Key Exchange(IKE) policy. Supported algorithms and key strengths - https://aka.ms/AA62kb0

definitions.description: Requires that prerequisites are deployed to the policy assignment scope. For details, visit https://aka.ms/gcpol. DISA (Defense Information Systems Agency) provides technical guides STIG (Security Technical Implementation Guide) to secure compute OS as required by Department of Defense (DoD). For more details, https://public.cyber.mil/stigs/.

Setting Internal Load Balancing Mode (ilbMode) to 'Web, Publishing' binds HTTP/HTTPS traffic on ports 80/443 and control/data channel ports for FTP to an ILB allocated Virtual Network Address.
