definitions.name: cd794351-e536-40f4-9750-503a463d8cad
definitions.display_name: Configure Function apps to disable public network access
definitions.description: Disable public network access for your Function apps so that it is not accessible over the public internet. This can reduce data leakage risks. Learn more at: https://aka.ms/app-service-private-endpoint.

definitions.name: cd870362-211d-4cad-9ad9-11e5ea4ebbc1
definitions.display_name: Public network access should be disabled for IoT Central
definitions.description: To improve the security of IoT Central, ensure that it isn't exposed to the public internet and can only be accessed from a private endpoint. Disable the public network access property as described in https://aka.ms/iotcentral-restrict-public-access. This option disables access from any public address space outside the Azure IP range, and denies all logins that match IP or virtual network-based firewall rules. This reduces data leakage risks.

definitions.name: cd8f7644-6fe8-4516-bded-0e465ead03ac
definitions.display_name: Azure Event Grid namespace MQTT broker should use private link
definitions.description: Azure Private Link lets you connect your virtual network to Azure services without a public IP address at the source or destination. The Private Link platform handles the connectivity between the consumer and services over the Azure backbone network. By mapping private endpoints to your Event Grid namespace instead of the entire service, you'll also be protected against data leakage risks. Learn more at: https://aka.ms/aeg-ns-privateendpoints.

definitions.name: cd906338-3453-47ba-9334-2d654bf845af
definitions.display_name: Azure Front Door Standard or Premium (Plus WAF) should have resource logs enabled
definitions.description: Enable Resource logs for Azure Front Door Standard or Premium (plus WAF) and stream to a Log Analytics workspace. Get detailed visibility into inbound web traffic and actions taken to mitigate attacks.

definitions.description: Resource logs should be enabled to track activities and events that take place on your resources and give you visibility and insights into any changes that occur. This policy deploys a diagnostic setting using a category group to route logs to a Log Analytics workspace for Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server (microsoft.dbforpostgresql/flexibleservers).

definitions.name: cddcbb7e-a7b1-4380-b4d8-45cf77b0d561

definitions.description: Private endpoints lets you connect your virtual network to Azure services without a public IP address at the source or destination. By mapping private endpoints to your resources, they'll be protected against data leakage risks. Learn more at: https://aka.ms/aeg-ns-privateendpoints.

definitions.description: Enable export to Event Hub of Microsoft Defender for Cloud data. This policy deploys an export to Event Hub configuration with your conditions and target Event Hub on the assigned scope. To deploy this policy on newly created subscriptions, open the Compliance tab, select the relevant non-compliant assignment and create a remediation task.

eventHubDetails.description: The Event Hub details of where the data should be exported to: Subscription, Event Hub Namespace, Event Hub, and Authorizations rules with 'Send' claim.

resourceGroupLocation.description: The location where the resource group and the export to Event Hub configuration are created.

resourceGroupName.description: The resource group name where the export to Event Hub configuration is created. If you enter a name for a resource group that doesn't exist, it'll be created in the subscription. Note that each resource group can only have one export to Event Hub configured.

definitions.name: ce39a96d-bf09-4b60-8c32-e85d52abea0f
definitions.display_name: A Microsoft Entra administrator should be provisioned for PostgreSQL flexible servers
definitions.description: Audit provisioning of a Microsoft Entra administrator for your PostgreSQL flexible server to enable Microsoft Entra authentication. Microsoft Entra authentication enables simplified permission management and centralized identity management of database users and other Microsoft services

definitions.name: ce6ebf1d-0b94-4df9-9257-d8cacc238b4f
definitions.display_name: Configure Azure Virtual Desktop workspaces to disable public network access
definitions.description: Disable public network access for your Azure Virtual Desktop workspace resource so the feed is not accessible over the public internet. This improves security and keeps your data safe. Learn more at: https://aka.ms/avdprivatelink.

definitions.description: Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible servers allows you to choose the redundancy option for your database server. It can be set to a geo-redundant backup storage in which the data is not only stored within the region in which your server is hosted, but is also replicated to a paired region to provide recovery option in case of a region failure. Configuring geo-redundant storage for backup is only allowed during server create.

definitions.name: cee51871-e572-4576-855c-047c820360f0
definitions.display_name: Certificates using RSA cryptography should have the specified minimum key size
definitions.description: Manage your organizational compliance requirements by specifying a minimum key size for RSA certificates stored in your key vault.

definitions.display_name: [Image Integrity] Kubernetes clusters should only use images signed by notation
definitions.description: Use images signed by notation to ensure that images come from trusted sources and will not be maliciously modified. For more info, visit https://aka.ms/aks/image-integrity

definitions.description: Enable transparent data encryption for Azure Synapse Analytics dedicated SQL pools to protect data-at-rest and meet compliance requirements. Please note that enabling transparent data encryption for the pool may impact query performance. More details can refer to https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2147714

definitions.name: cfb11c26-f069-4c14-8e36-56c394dae5af

definitions.description: Disabling local authentication methods improves security by ensuring that Azure Service Bus namespaces exclusively require Microsoft Entra ID identities for authentication. Learn more at: https://aka.ms/disablelocalauth-sb.

definitions.display_name: [Preview]: Azure Backup should be enabled on Azure file shares
definitions.description: Ensure protection of your Azure file shares by enabling Azure Backup. Azure Backup is a secure and cost effective data protection solution for Azure.

definitions.name: cfdc5972-75b3-4418-8ae1-7f5c36839390
definitions.display_name: Configure Microsoft Defender for Storage to be enabled
definitions.description:
Microsoft Defender for Storage is an Azure-native layer of security intelligence that detects potential threats to your storage accounts.
This policy will enable all Defender for Storage capabilities; Activity Monitoring, Malware Scanning and Sensitive Data Threat Detection. To learn more about Defender for Storage capabilities and benefits, visit aka.ms/DefenderForStorage.

definitions.name: d0793b48-0edc-4296-a390-4c75d1bdfd71
definitions.display_name: Container registries should not allow unrestricted network access
definitions.description: Azure container registries by default accept connections over the internet from hosts on any network. To protect your registries from potential threats, allow access from only specific private endpoints, public IP addresses or address ranges. If your registry doesn't have network rules configured, it will appear in the unhealthy resources. Learn more about Container Registry network rules here: https://aka.ms/acr/privatelink, https://aka.ms/acr/portal/public-network and https://aka.ms/acr/vnet.

definitions.description: Azure Database for PostgreSQL supports connecting your Azure Database for PostgreSQL server to client applications using Secure Sockets Layer (SSL). Enforcing SSL connections between your database server and your client applications helps protect against 'man in the middle' attacks by encrypting the data stream between the server and your application. This configuration enforces that SSL is always enabled for accessing your database server.

definitions.description: Providing an auto-generated domain name label scope for your app ensures that the app can be accessed via a unique URL. For more information, see https://aka.ms/app-service-autoGeneratedDomainNameLabelScope.

definitions.description: Private endpoints connect your virtual networks to Azure services without a public IP address at the source or destination. By mapping private endpoints to Azure Key Vault Managed HSM, you can reduce data leakage risks. Learn more at: https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/key-vault/managed-hsm/private-link.

definitions.description: Automatically prevent installation of the legacy Log Analytics Agent as the final step of migrating from legacy agents to Azure Monitor Agent. After you have uninstalled existing legacy extensions, this policy will deny all future installations of the legacy agent extension on Windows virtual machines. Learn more: https://aka.ms/migratetoAMA

definitions.name: d242c24b-bac7-439e-8af7-22d7dcfd3c4f
definitions.display_name: App Configuration should use geo-replication
definitions.description: Use the geo-replication feature to create replicas in other locations of your current configuration store for enhanced resiliency and availability. Additionally, having multi-region replicas lets you better distribute load, lower latency, protect against datacenter outages, and compartmentalize globally distributed workloads. Learn more at: https://aka.ms/appconfig/geo-replication.

definitions.description: The Guest Configuration extension requires a system assigned managed identity. Azure virtual machines in the scope of this policy will be non-compliant when they have the Guest Configuration extension installed but do not have a system assigned managed identity. Learn more at https://aka.ms/gcpol

definitions.name: d2e7ea85-6b44-4317-a0be-1b951587f626
definitions.display_name: Kubernetes clusters should not grant CAP_SYS_ADMIN security capabilities
definitions.description: To reduce the attack surface of your containers, restrict CAP_SYS_ADMIN Linux capabilities. For more information, see https://aka.ms/kubepolicydoc.

bringYourOwnUserAssignedManagedIdentity.description: Enable this to use your pre-created user-assigned managed identity. The pre-created identity MUST exist within the subscription otherwise the policy deployment will fail. If enabled, ensure that the User-Assigned Identity Name and Identity Resource Group Name parameters match the pre-created identity. If not enabled, the policy will create per subscription, per resource user-assigned managed identities in a new resource group named 'Built-In-Identity-RG'.

definitions.description: This policy audits any Azure SQL Database with long-term geo-redundant backup not enabled.

definitions.name: d3903bdf-ab85-4cce-85d3-2934d77629d4
definitions.display_name: [Preview]: Virtual Machine Scale Sets should be Zone Resilient
definitions.description: Virtual Machine Scale Sets can be configured to be either Zone Aligned, Zone Redundant, or neither. Virtual Machine Scale Sets that have exactly one entry in their zones array are considered Zone Aligned. In contrast, Virtual Machine Scale Sets with 3 or more entries in their zones array and a capacity of at least 3 are recognized as Zone Redundant. This policy helps identify and enforce these resilience configurations.

resourceLocation.description: Resource Location must be in the same location as the Storage Account.

This policy identifies and enforces the Zone Redundancy configuration for Service Bus instances.

After disabling, Microsoft Entra ID becomes the only access method, which allows maintaining minimum privilege principle and granular control. Learn more at: https://aka.ms/AI/auth

definitions.display_name: Managed disks should use a specific set of disk encryption sets for the customer-managed key encryption
definitions.description: Requiring a specific set of disk encryption sets to be used with managed disks give you control over the keys used for encryption at rest. You are able to select the allowed encrypted sets and all others are rejected when attached to a disk. Learn more at https://aka.ms/disks-cmk.

definitions.description: Ensures that every API Management policy includes the <base /> tag at the beginning of each policy section - <inbound>, <outbound>, <backend>, and <on-error> - to inherit policies from parent scopes. Omitting <base /> can lead to bypassing shared rules such as authentication, logging, rate limits, and other critical controls. Learn more: https://aka.ms/apim/policies/how-to

definitions.name: d550e854-df1a-4de9-bf44-cd894b39a95e
definitions.display_name: Azure Monitor Logs for Application Insights should be linked to a Log Analytics workspace
definitions.description: Link the Application Insights component to a Log Analytics workspace for logs encryption. Customer-managed keys are commonly required to meet regulatory compliance and for more control over the access to your data in Azure Monitor. Linking your component to a Log Analytics workspace that's enabled with a customer-managed key, ensures that your Application Insights logs meet this compliance requirement, see https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/platform/customer-managed-keys.

definitions.display_name: Azure NetApp Files Volumes should not use NFSv3 protocol type
definitions.description: Disallow the use of NFSv3 protocol type to prevent unsecure access to volumes. NFSv4.1 with Kerberos protocol should be used to access NFS volumes to ensure data integrity and encryption.

definitions.name: d56a5a7c-72d7-42bc-8ceb-3baf4c0eae03
definitions.display_name: Deploy Diagnostic Settings for Data Lake Analytics to Log Analytics workspace
definitions.description: Deploys the diagnostic settings for Data Lake Analytics to stream to a regional Log Analytics workspace when any Data Lake Analytics which is missing this diagnostic settings is created or updated.

logAnalytics.description: Select Log Analytics workspace from dropdown list. If this workspace is outside of the scope of the assignment you must manually grant 'Log Analytics Contributor' permissions (or similar) to the policy assignment's principal ID.

definitions.display_name: Configure Linux Arc Machines to be associated with a Data Collection Rule or a Data Collection Endpoint
definitions.description: Deploy Association to link Linux Arc machines to the specified Data Collection Rule or the specified Data Collection Endpoint. The list of locations are updated over time as support is increased.

dcrResourceId.description: Resource Id of the Data Collection Rule or the Data Collection Endpoint to be applied on the Linux machines in scope.

definitions.name: d627d7c6-ded5-481a-8f2e-7e16b1e6faf6
definitions.display_name: Deploy - Configure IoT Central to use private DNS zones
definitions.description: Azure Private DNS provides a reliable, secure DNS service to manage and resolve domain names in a virtual network without the need to add a custom DNS solution. You can use private DNS zones to override the DNS resolution by using your own custom domain names for a private endpoint. This policy deploys a private DNS Zone for IoT Central private endpoints.

privateDnsZoneId.description: Specifies the private DNS zone to use to configure private endpoint

definitions.name: d639b3af-a535-4bef-8dcf-15078cddf5e2
definitions.display_name: App Service app slots should have resource logs enabled
definitions.description: Audit enabling of resource logs on the app. This enables you to recreate activity trails for investigation purposes if a security incident occurs or your network is compromised.

definitions.display_name: Event Hub should use a virtual network service endpoint
definitions.description: This policy audits any Event Hub not configured to use a virtual network service endpoint.

definitions.name: d6545c6b-dd9d-4265-91e6-0b451e2f1c50
definitions.display_name: App Service Environment should have TLS 1.0 and 1.1 disabled
definitions.description: TLS 1.0 and 1.1 are out-of-date protocols that do not support modern cryptographic algorithms. Disabling inbound TLS 1.0 and 1.1 traffic helps secure apps in an App Service Environment.

definitions.name: d6588149-9f06-462c-a076-56aece45b5ba
definitions.display_name: Azure Backup Vaults should use customer-managed keys for encrypting backup data. Also an option to enforce Infra Encryption.
definitions.description: This policy follows the 'effect' if Encryption Settings are enabled for Backup vaults in the scope. Additionally, option to check if Backup Vault also has Infrastructure Encryption enabled. Learn more at https://aka.ms/az-backup-vault-encryption-at-rest-with-cmk. Please note that when 'Deny' effect is used, it would need you to enable Encryption Settings on the existing Backup Vaults in order to allow other update operations on the vault go through.

definitions.display_name: Storage account should restrict IP rules in storage account firewall settings.
definitions.description: This policy applies exclusively to Mission Platform products and services; usage outside of these scopes is not supported. IP Rules in Storage Account Firewalls are restricted.

definitions.display_name: Azure AI Services resources should use Azure Private Link
definitions.description: Azure Private Link lets you connect your virtual network to Azure services without a public IP address at the source or destination. The Private Link platform reduces data leakage risks by handling the connectivity between the consumer and services over the Azure backbone network. Learn more about private links at: https://aka.ms/AzurePrivateLink/Overview

definitions.name: d6c69680-54f0-4349-af10-94dd05f4225e

definitions.description: Windows machines should have the specified Group Policy settings in the category 'Security Options - Microsoft Network Client' for Microsoft network client/server and SMB v1. This policy requires that the Guest Configuration prerequisites have been deployed to the policy assignment scope. For details, visit https://aka.ms/gcpol.

definitions.name: d6eeba80-df61-4de5-8772-bc1b7852ba6b
definitions.display_name: Configure Azure Arc Private Link Scopes with private endpoints
definitions.description: Private endpoints connect your virtual networks to Azure services without a public IP address at the source or destination. definitions.description: This policy audits if the immutable vaults property is enabled for Recovery Services vaults in the scope. This helps protect your backup data from being deleted before its intended expiry. Learn more at https://aka.ms/AB-ImmutableVaults.

definitions.name: d77df159-718b-4aca-b94b-8e8890a98231

definitions.description: Setting Privilege escalation to false increases security by preventing containers from allowing privilege escalation such as via set-user-ID or set-group-ID file mode.

definitions.name: d77f191e-2338-45d0-b6d4-4ee1c586a192

definitions.description: Disabling local authentication methods for FTP deployments improves security by ensuring that function app slots exclusively require Microsoft Entra identities for authentication. Learn more at: https://aka.ms/app-service-disable-basic-auth.

definitions.name: f0308946-498a-43fd-8d44-a75b47cd2aef
definitions.display_name: Storage accounts should restrict network access (excluding storage accounts managed by Azure Red Hat OpenShift)
definitions.description: Network access to storage accounts should be restricted. Configure network rules so only applications from allowed networks can access the storage account. To allow connections from specific internet or on-premises clients, access can be granted to traffic from specific Azure virtual networks or to public internet IP address ranges. Storage accounts in resource groups managed by Azure Red Hat OpenShift are excluded from evaluation.

definitions.name: f06ddb64-5fa3-4b77-b166-acb36f7f6042
definitions.display_name: Kubernetes cluster pods and containers should only run with approved user and group IDs
definitions.description: Control the user, primary group, supplemental group and file system group IDs that pods and containers can use to run in a Kubernetes Cluster. This policy is generally available for Kubernetes Service (AKS), and preview for Azure Arc enabled Kubernetes. For more information, see https://aka.ms/kubepolicydoc.

definitions.name: f08edf17-5de2-4966-8c62-a50a3f4368ff
definitions.display_name: Enable logging by category group for Video Analyzers (microsoft.media/videoanalyzers) to Storage
definitions.description: Resource logs should be enabled to track activities and events that take place on your resources and give you visibility and insights into any changes that occur. This policy deploys a diagnostic setting using a category group to route logs to a Storage Account for Video Analyzers (microsoft.media/videoanalyzers).

resourceLocation.description: Resource Location must be in the same location as the Storage Account.

storageAccount.description: Full path (resourceId) to the storage account.

definitions.name: f08f556c-12ff-464d-a7de-40cb5b6cccec
definitions.display_name: Configure ChangeTracking Extension for Windows virtual machines
definitions.description: Configure Windows virtual machines to automatically install the ChangeTracking Extension to enable File Integrity Monitoring(FIM) in Azure Security Center. FIM examines operating system files, Windows registries, application software, Linux system files, and more, for changes that might indicate an attack. The extension can be installed in virtual machines and locations supported by Azure Monitor Agent.

definitions.name: f0a5beeb-4b9b-4a3f-ba85-4f4b06afb598
definitions.display_name: Azure Virtual Desktop Host Pools should restrict RDP property configurations
definitions.description: This policy applies exclusively to Mission Platform products and services; usage outside of these scopes is not supported. Ensures that Azure Virtual Desktop Host Pools enforce approved RDP property configurations, reducing the attack surface by limiting remote desktop protocol settings.

definitions.name: f0d25196-1ea4-49e1-ad53-ccada27b4862
definitions.display_name: Enable logging by category group for DICOM service (microsoft.healthcareapis/workspaces/dicomservices) to Log Analytics
definitions.description: Resource logs should be enabled to track activities and events that take place on your resources and give you visibility and insights into any changes that occur. This policy deploys a diagnostic setting using a category group to route logs to a Log Analytics workspace for DICOM service (microsoft.healthcareapis/workspaces/dicomservices).

definitions.name: f0e5abd0-2554-4736-b7c0-4ffef23475ef
definitions.display_name: Queue Storage should use customer-managed key for encryption
definitions.description: Secure your queue storage with greater flexibility using customer-managed keys. When you specify a customer-managed key, that key is used to protect and control access to the key that encrypts your data. Using customer-managed keys provides additional capabilities to control rotation of the key encryption key or cryptographically erase data.

definitions.name: f0e6e85b-9b9f-4a4b-b67b-f730d42f1b0b
definitions.display_name: App Service apps should use the latest TLS version
definitions.description: Periodically, newer versions are released for TLS either due to security flaws, include additional functionality, and enhance speed. Upgrade to the latest TLS version for App Service apps to take advantage of security fixes, if any, and/or new functionalities of the latest version.

definitions.name: f0fcf93c-c063-4071-9668-c47474bd3564
definitions.display_name: Configure Service Bus namespaces to use private DNS zones
definitions.description: Use private DNS zones to override the DNS resolution for a private endpoint. A private DNS zone links to your virtual network to resolve to Service Bus namespaces. Learn more at: https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/service-bus-messaging/private-link-service.

privateDnsZoneId.description: Specifies the private DNS zone to use to configure private endpoint

definitions.name: f110a506-2dcb-422e-bcea-d533fc8c35e2
definitions.display_name: Azure Machine Learning compute instances should be recreated to get the latest software updates
definitions.description: Ensure Azure Machine Learning compute instances run on the latest available operating system. Security is improved and vulnerabilities reduced by running with the latest security patches. For more information, visit https://aka.ms/azureml-ci-updates/.

definitions.name: f131c8c5-a54a-4888-1efc-158928924bc1
definitions.display_name: Require developers to build security architecture
definitions.description: CMA_C1612 - Require developers to build security architecture

definitions.name: f1525828-9a90-4fcf-be48-268cdd02361e
definitions.display_name: Deploy Workflow Automation for Microsoft Defender for Cloud alerts
definitions.description: Enable automation of Microsoft Defender for Cloud alerts. This policy deploys a workflow automation with your conditions and triggers on the assigned scope. To deploy this policy on newly created subscriptions, open the Compliance tab, select the relevant non-compliant assignment and create a remediation task.

logicAppResourceId.description: The Logic App that is triggered.

logicAppTrigger.description: The trigger connector of the logic app that is triggered. Possible values: 'Manual (Incoming HTTP request)', 'When an Azure Security Center Alert is created or triggered'.
allowed_values: When an Azure Security Center Alert is created or triggered

resourceGroupLocation.description: The location where the resource group and the workflow automation are created.

resourceGroupName.description: The resource group name where the workflow automation is created. If you enter a name for a resource group that doesn't exist, it'll be created in the subscription.

definitions.name: f16a3ca9-b57a-4392-b660-4c1f8442aa8d
definitions.display_name: [Preview]: SQL Elastic database pools should be Zone Redundant
definitions.description: SQL Elastic database pools can be configured to be Zone Redundant or not. SQL Elastic database pools are Zone Redundant if it's 'zoneRedundant' property is set to 'true'. Enforcing this policy helps ensure that Event Hubs are appropriately configured for zone resilience, reducing the risk of downtime during zone outages.

definitions.name: f1776c76-f58c-4245-a8d0-2b207198dc8b
definitions.display_name: Virtual networks should use specified virtual network gateway
definitions.description: This policy audits any virtual network if the default route does not point to the specified virtual network gateway.

virtualNetworkGatewayId.description: Resource Id of the virtual network gateway. Example: /subscriptions/YourSubscriptionId/resourceGroups/YourResourceGroup/providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworkGateways/Name

definitions.name: f17d891d-ff20-46f2-bad3-9e0a5403a4d3
definitions.display_name: Linux Arc-enabled machines should have Azure Monitor Agent installed
definitions.description: Linux Arc-enabled machines should be monitored and secured through the deployed Azure Monitor Agent. The Azure Monitor Agent collects telemetry data from the guest OS. This policy will audit Arc-enabled machines in supported regions. Learn more: https://aka.ms/AMAOverview.

definitions.name: f19b0c83-716f-4b81-85e3-2dbf057c35d6
definitions.display_name: Disable Cross Subscription Restore for Azure Recovery Services vaults
definitions.description: Disable or PermanentlyDisable Cross Subscription Restore for your Recovery Services vault so that restore targets cannot be in different subscription from the vault subscription. Learn more at: https://aka.ms/csrenhancements.

definitions.name: f1cc7827-022c-473e-836e-5a51cae0b249
definitions.display_name: API Management secret named values should be stored in Azure Key Vault
definitions.description: Named values are a collection of name and value pairs in each API Management service. Secret values can be stored either as encrypted text in API Management (custom secrets) or by referencing secrets in Azure Key Vault. To improve security of API Management and secrets, reference secret named values from Azure Key Vault. Azure Key Vault supports granular access management and secret rotation policies.

definitions.name: f2143251-70de-4e81-87a8-36cee5a2f29d
definitions.display_name: Windows machines should meet requirements for 'Security Settings - Account Policies'
definitions.description: Windows machines should have the specified Group Policy settings in the category 'Security Settings - Account Policies' for password history, age, length, complexity, and storing passwords using reversible encryption. This policy requires that the Guest Configuration prerequisites have been deployed to the policy assignment scope. For details, visit https://aka.ms/gcpol.

definitions.display_name: Manage a secure surveillance camera system

definitions.name: f32ca068-2ada-4705-b5b5-84ce89422846
definitions.display_name: [Preview]: Configure backup for Azure Files Shares with a given tag to a new recovery services vault with a new policy
definitions.description: Enforce backup for all Azure Files by deploying a recovery services vault in the same location and resource group as the storage account. Doing this is useful when different application teams in your organization are allocated separate resource groups and need to manage their own backups and restores. You can optionally include Azure Files in storage accounts containing a specified tag to control the scope of assignment.

vaultLocation.description: Location of the FileShares. The FileShares should be in the same location as the vault.

vaultName.description: Name of the Recovery Services Vault where backups should be registered.

definitions.display_name: Configure Arc-enabled Servers with SQL Server extension installed to enable or disable SQL best practices assessment.
definitions.description: Enable or disable SQL best practices assessment on the SQL server instances on your Arc-enabled servers to evaluate best practices. Learn more at https://aka.ms/azureArcBestPracticesAssessment.

isEnabled.description: Should be true to enable the assessment for the selected scope, false otherwise.

laWorkspaceId.description: The name of the LA workspace that needs to be linked to collect the results of the assessment.

laWorkspaceLocation.description: The location of the Log Analytics workspace. E.g eastus, westus.

definitions.description: This policy applies exclusively to Mission Platform products and services; usage outside of these scopes is not supported. Restrict Site Access Rules to Specified Sources.

definitions.name: f380edf5-de79-4862-bd57-ee407d8bd8b6
definitions.display_name: Function app slots should enable configuration routing to Azure Virtual Network
definitions.description: By default, configuration traffic (image pull, content share, backup/restore) is not routed through regional VNET integration. For API < 2024-11-01, set 'vnetImagePullEnabled', 'vnetContentShareEnabled', 'vnetBackupRestoreEnabled' to true. For API >= 2024-11-01, set the corresponding 'outboundVnetRouting' properties or 'outboundVnetRouting.allTraffic' to true. Not for Flex/Consumption plans. Learn more: https://aka.ms/appservice-vnet-configuration-routing.

definitions.description: Azure Private Link lets you connect your virtual network to Azure services without a public IP address at the source or destination. The Private Link platform handles the connectivity between the consumer and services over the Azure backbone network. By mapping private endpoints to diskAccesses, data leakage risks are reduced. Learn more about private links at: https://aka.ms/disksprivatelinksdoc.

definitions.description: This policy blocks network interfaces from connecting to a virtual network or subnet that is not approved. https://aka.ms/VirtualEnclaves

definitions.description: This policy adds a user-assigned managed identity to virtual machines hosted in Azure that are supported by Guest Configuration. A user-assigned managed identity is a prerequisite for all Guest Configuration assignments and must be added to machines before using any Guest Configuration policy definitions. For more information on Guest Configuration, visit https://aka.ms/gcpol.

definitions.display_name: Configure managed disk network access policy to deny all
definitions.description: This policy applies exclusively to Mission Platform products and services; usage outside of these scopes is not supported. Compute policy enforces that Managed Disks cannot be exported.

definitions.description: Periodically, newer versions are released for PHP software either due to security flaws or to include additional functionality. Using the latest PHP version for App Service apps is recommended in order to take advantage of security fixes, if any, and/or new functionalities of the latest version. This policy only applies to Linux apps. This policy requires you to specify a PHP version that meets your requirements.

definitions.description: Disabling local authentication methods for FTP deployments improves security by ensuring that App Service slots exclusively require Microsoft Entra identities for authentication. Learn more at: https://aka.ms/app-service-disable-basic-auth.

definitions.description: Pod FlexVolume volumes should only use allowed drivers in a Kubernetes cluster. This policy is generally available for Kubernetes Service (AKS), and preview for Azure Arc enabled Kubernetes. For more information, see https://aka.ms/kubepolicydoc.

definitions.name: f4b53539-8df9-40e4-86c6-6b607703bd4e
definitions.display_name: Disk encryption should be enabled on Azure Data Explorer
definitions.description: Enabling disk encryption helps protect and safeguard your data to meet your organizational security and compliance commitments.

definitions.name: f4c68484-132f-41f9-9b6d-3e4b1cb55036
definitions.display_name: Configure SQL servers to have auditing enabled
definitions.description: To ensure the operations performed against your SQL assets are captured, SQL servers should have auditing enabled. This is sometimes required for compliance with regulatory standards.

storageAccountsResourceGroup.description: Auditing writes database events to an audit log in your Azure Storage account (a storage account will be created in each region where a SQL Server is created that will be shared by all servers in that region). Important - for proper operation of Auditing do not delete or rename the resource group or the storage accounts.

resourceLocation.description: Resource Location must be in the same location as the Event Hub Namespace.

definitions.name: f58e8c0a-3c79-431a-abf8-cd1b895478e8
definitions.display_name: [Preview]: Container Instances should be Zone Aligned
definitions.description: Container Instances can be configured to be Zone Aligned or not. They are considered Zone Aligned if they have only one entry in their zones array. This policy ensures that they are configured to operate within a single availability zone.

definitions.name: f59276f0-5740-4aaf-821d-45d185aa210e
definitions.display_name: Configure diagnostic settings for Azure Machine Learning Workspaces to Log Analytics workspace
definitions.description: Deploys the diagnostic settings for Azure Machine Learning Workspaces to stream resource logs to a Log Analytics Workspace when any Azure Machine Learning Workspace which is missing this diagnostic settings is created or updated.

logAnalytics.description: Select Log Analytics workspace from dropdown list. If this workspace is outside of the scope of the assignment you must manually grant 'Log Analytics Contributor' permissions (or similar) to the policy assignment's principal ID.

definitions.name: f5c0bfb3-acea-47b1-b477-b0edcdf6edc1
definitions.display_name: App Service app slots should enable outbound application traffic routing to Azure Virtual Network
definitions.description: By default, regional VNET integration routes only RFC1918 traffic. Set 'vnetRouteAllEnabled' (API < 2024-11-01) or 'outboundVnetRouting.applicationTraffic' (API >= 2024-11-01) to route application traffic via the virtual network. Alternatively, set 'outboundVnetRouting.allTraffic' to route all traffic. Configuration traffic is handled separately by the configuration routing policy.

definitions.name: f5c8be13-ecfa-4ed7-beee-fcd8a6d9519d
definitions.display_name: Storage accounts should use customer-managed key for encryption (excluding storage accounts managed by Azure Red Hat OpenShift)
definitions.description: Secure your blob and file storage account with greater flexibility using customer-managed keys. When you specify a customer-managed key, that key is used to protect and control access to the key that encrypts your data. Using customer-managed keys provides additional capabilities to control rotation of the key encryption key or cryptographically erase data. Storage accounts in resource groups managed by Azure Red Hat OpenShift are excluded from evaluation.

definitions.name: f5ed3f7a-cf5d-4ee6-9ede-b5d5192ccf81
definitions.display_name: Configure logfiles.retention_days to at least 7 days for PostgreSQL flexible servers
definitions.description: Configures logfiles.retention_days to at least 7 days for PostgreSQL flexible servers to ensure server logs are retained for sufficient time to support auditing and forensic investigations.

definitions.name: f628ffa2-2900-47aa-ab09-3ecb844f2ae8
definitions.display_name: Configure file share with Microsoft.FileShares to use private DNS zones
definitions.description: To access the private endpoint(s) for Microsoft.FileShares resources, you need to configure your DNS to resolve the correct names to your private endpoint's private IP addresses. This policy creates the requisite Azure Private DNS Zone and A records for the interfaces of your Microsoft.FileShares private endpoint(s).

privateDnsZoneId.description: Private DNS Zone Identifier

definitions.name: f62b9eab-b489-4388-9874-b0a62ca31327
definitions.display_name: Enable logging by category group for Azure Database for MariaDB servers (microsoft.dbformariadb/servers) to Log Analytics
definitions.description: Resource logs should be enabled to track activities and events that take place on your resources and give you visibility and insights into any changes that occur. This policy deploys a diagnostic setting using a category group to route logs to a Log Analytics workspace for Azure Database for MariaDB servers (microsoft.dbformariadb/servers).

definitions.name: f6358610-e532-4236-b178-4c65865eb262
definitions.display_name: [Preview]: Virtual machines guest attestation status should be healthy
definitions.description: Guest attestation is performed by sending a trusted log (TCGLog) to an attestation server. The server uses these logs to determine whether boot components are trustworthy. This assessment is intended to detect compromises of the boot chain which might be the result of a bootkit or rootkit infection. This assessment only applies to Trusted Launch enabled virtual machines that have Guest Attestation extension installed.

definitions.name: f655e522-adff-494d-95c2-52d4f6d56a42
definitions.display_name: [Preview]: Guest Attestation extension should be installed on supported Windows virtual machines scale sets
definitions.description: Install Guest Attestation extension on supported virtual machines scale sets to allow Azure Security Center to proactively attest and monitor the boot integrity. Once installed, boot integrity will be attested via Remote Attestation. This assessment applies to Trusted Launch and Confidential Windows virtual machine scale sets.

definitions.name: f6794ab8-9a7d-3b24-76ab-265d3646232b
definitions.display_name: Provide role-based training on suspicious activities
definitions.description: CMA_C1097 - Provide role-based training on suspicious activities

definitions.name: f692cc79-76fb-4c61-8861-467e454ac6f8
definitions.display_name: Subscribe eligible Arc-enabled SQL Servers instances to Extended Security Updates.
definitions.description: Subscribe eligible Arc-enabled SQL Servers instances with License Type set to Paid or PAYG to Extended Security Updates. More on extended security updates https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2239401.

enableESU.description: Should be true to enable the ESU subscription for every SQL Server instance in the selected scope, false otherwise.

definitions.name: f69cd8b8-9a6e-46b4-be84-244e8b127944
definitions.display_name: Multi Factor Authentication Enforcement - Delete

definitions.name: fda9cd0b-094c-4cd5-ac2a-5e06e5277c45
definitions.display_name: [Preview]: Azure Backup Extension should be installed in AKS clusters
definitions.description: Ensure protection installation of backup extension in your AKS Clusters to leverage Azure Backup. Azure Backup for AKS is a secure and cloud native data protection solution for AKS clusters

definitions.name: fdccbe47-f3e3-4213-ad5d-ea459b2fa077
definitions.display_name: Public network access should be disabled for MariaDB servers
definitions.description: Disable the public network access property to improve security and ensure your Azure Database for MariaDB can only be accessed from a private endpoint. This configuration strictly disables access from any public address space outside of Azure IP range, and denies all logins that match IP or virtual network-based firewall rules.

definitions.name: fe1c9040-c46a-4e81-9aea-c7850fbb3aa6
definitions.display_name: CORS should not allow every domain to access your FHIR Service
definitions.description: Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) should not allow all domains to access your FHIR Service. To protect your FHIR Service, remove access for all domains and explicitly define the domains allowed to connect.

definitions.name: fe2dff43-0a8c-95df-0432-cb1c794b17d0
definitions.display_name: Notify users of system logon or access
definitions.description: CMA_0382 - Notify users of system logon or access

definitions.name: fe3fd216-4f83-4fc1-8984-2bbec80a3418
definitions.display_name: Cognitive Services accounts should use a managed identity
definitions.description: Assigning a managed identity to your Cognitive Service account helps ensure secure authentication. This identity is used by this Cognitive service account to communicate with other Azure services, like Azure Key Vault, in a secure way without you having to manage any credentials.

definitions.name: fe4e11ff-f561-4d4a-877c-256cc0b6470e
definitions.display_name: [Preview]: Audit SSH security posture for Windows
definitions.description: This policy audits SSH server security configuration on Windows Server 2019, 2022, and 2025 machines (Azure VMs and Arc-enabled machines). For more information including pre-requisites, settings in scope, defaults, and customization, see https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/osconfig/overviewsshposture-control-windows.

definitions.name: fe74a23d-79e4-401c-bd0d-fd7a5b35af32
definitions.display_name: [Preview]: Sets Kubernetes cluster Pod securityContext.runAsUser fields to 1000, a non-root user id
definitions.description: Reduces attack surface introduced by escalating privileges as root user in the presence of security vulnerabilities.

definitions.name: fe83a0eb-a853-422d-aac2-1bffd182c5d0
definitions.display_name: Storage accounts should have the specified minimum TLS version
definitions.description: Configure a minimum TLS version for secure communication between the client application and the storage account. To minimize security risk, the recommended minimum TLS version is the latest released version, which is currently TLS 1.2.

definitions.name: fe85de62-a656-4b79-9d94-d95c89319bd9
definitions.display_name: Enable logging by category group for Log Analytics workspaces (microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces) to Storage
definitions.description: Resource logs should be enabled to track activities and events that take place on your resources and give you visibility and insights into any changes that occur. This policy deploys a diagnostic setting using a category group to route logs to a Storage Account for Log Analytics workspaces (microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces).

resourceLocation.description: Resource Location must be in the same location as the Storage Account.

storageAccount.description: Full path (resourceId) to the storage account.

definitions.name: fe8684d6-3c5b-45c0-a08b-fa92653c2e1c
definitions.display_name: Stream Analytics job should connect to trusted inputs and outputs
definitions.description: Ensure that Stream Analytics jobs do not have arbitrary Input, Output, or Function binding connections that are not defined in the allow-list. This checks that Stream Analytics jobs don't exfiltrate data by connecting to arbitrary sinks outside your organization.

definitions.name: fe8a9af4-a003-4c7d-b7a4-b9808310c4f8
definitions.display_name: Public IPs and Public IP prefixes should have FirstPartyUsage tag
definitions.description: Ensure all Public IP addresses and Public IP Prefixes have a FirstPartyUsage tag.

definitions.name: fea83f6c-a18a-4338-8f1f-80ecba4c5643
definitions.display_name: Enable logging by category group for Backup vaults (microsoft.dataprotection/backupvaults) to Log Analytics
definitions.description: Resource logs should be enabled to track activities and events that take place on your resources and give you visibility and insights into any changes that occur. This policy deploys a diagnostic setting using a category group to route logs to a Log Analytics workspace for Backup vaults (microsoft.dataprotection/backupvaults).

definitions.name: febd0533-8e55-448f-b837-bd0e06f16469
definitions.display_name: Kubernetes cluster containers should only use allowed images
definitions.description: Use images from trusted registries to reduce the Kubernetes cluster's exposure risk to unknown vulnerabilities, security issues and malicious images. For more information, see https://aka.ms/kubepolicydoc.

allowedContainerImagesRegex.description: The RegEx rule used to match allowed container image field in a Kubernetes cluster. For example, to allow any Azure Container Registry image by matching partial path: ^[^\/]+\.azurecr\.io\/.+$ and for multiple registries: ^([^\/]+\.azurecr\.io|registry\.io)\/.+$

definitions.name: fed6510d-00b9-40db-a347-933125a6a327
definitions.display_name: [Preview]: Prevents init containers from being ran as root by setting runAsNotRoot to true.
definitions.description: Setting runAsNotRoot to true increases security by preventing containers from being ran as root.

definitions.name: feedbf84-6b99-488c-acc2-71c829aa5ffc
definitions.display_name: SQL databases should have vulnerability findings resolved
definitions.description: Monitor vulnerability assessment scan results and recommendations for how to remediate database vulnerabilities.

definitions.name: ff05e24e-195c-447e-b322-5e90c9f9f366
definitions.display_name: Container registries should have repository scoped access token disabled.
definitions.description: Disable repository scoped access tokens for your registry so that repositories are not accessible by tokens. Disabling local authentication methods like admin user, repository scoped access tokens and anonymous pull improves security by ensuring that container registries exclusively require Azure Active Directory identities for authentication. Learn more at: https://aka.ms/acr/authentication.

definitions.name: ff136354-1c92-76dc-2dab-80fb7c6a9f1a
definitions.display_name: Observe and report security weaknesses
definitions.description: CMA_0384 - Observe and report security weaknesses

definitions.name: ff1efad2-6b09-54cc-01bf-d386c4d558a8
definitions.display_name: Secure the interface to external systems
definitions.description: CMA_0491 - Secure the interface to external systems

definitions.name: ff1f1879-a60d-4f23-9641-41e7391ec19a
definitions.display_name: Azure Application Gateway should be deployed with Azure WAF
definitions.description: Requires Azure Application Gateway resources to be deployed with Azure WAF.

definitions.name: ff25f3c8-b739-4538-9d07-3d6d25cfb255
definitions.display_name: Keys using elliptic curve cryptography should have the specified curve names
definitions.description: Keys backed by elliptic curve cryptography can have different curve names. Some applications are only compatible with specific elliptic curve keys. Enforce the types of elliptic curve keys that are allowed to be created in your environment.

definitions.name: ffb6f416-7bd2-4488-8828-56585fef2be9
definitions.display_name: Deploy export to Log Analytics workspace for Microsoft Defender for Cloud data
definitions.description: Enable export to Log Analytics workspace of Microsoft Defender for Cloud data. This policy deploys an export to Log Analytics workspace configuration with your conditions and target workspace on the assigned scope. To deploy this policy on newly created subscriptions, open the Compliance tab, select the relevant non-compliant assignment and create a remediation task.

resourceGroupLocation.description: The location where the resource group and the export to Log Analytics workspace configuration are created.

resourceGroupName.description: The resource group name where the export to Log Analytics workspace configuration is created. If you enter a name for a resource group that doesn't exist, it'll be created in the subscription. Note that each resource group can only have one export to Log Analytics workspace configured.

workspaceResourceId.description: The Log Analytics workspace of where the data should be exported to.

definitions.name: ffdaa742-0d6f-726f-3eac-6e6c34e36c93
definitions.display_name: Establish usage restrictions for mobile code technologies
definitions.description: CMA_C1652 - Establish usage restrictions for mobile code technologies

definitions.name: ffe25541-3853-4f4e-b71d-064422294b11
definitions.display_name: API Management should have username and password authentication disabled
definitions.description: To better secure developer portal, username and password authentication in API Management should be disabled. Configure user authentication through Azure AD or Azure AD B2C identity providers and disable the default username and password authentication.

definitions.name: ffe49e3d-50dd-4137-8fe5-6877c4384b69
definitions.display_name: Enable logging by category group for microsoft.workloads/sapvirtualinstances to Event Hub
definitions.description: Resource logs should be enabled to track activities and events that take place on your resources and give you visibility and insights into any changes that occur. This policy deploys a diagnostic setting using a category group to route logs to an Event Hub for microsoft.workloads/sapvirtualinstances.

eventHubAuthorizationRuleId.description: Event Hub Authorization Rule Id - the authorization rule needs to be at Event Hub namespace level. e.g. /subscriptions/{subscription Id}/resourceGroups/{resource group}/providers/Microsoft.EventHub/namespaces/{Event Hub namespace}/authorizationrules/{authorization rule}

resourceLocation.description: Resource Location must be in the same location as the Event Hub Namespace.

definitions.name: ffea18d9-13de-6505-37f3-4c1f88070ad7
definitions.display_name: Review cloud service provider's compliance with policies and agreements
definitions.description: CMA_0469 - Review cloud service provider's compliance with policies and agreements

definitions.name: ffea632e-4e3a-4424-bf78-10e179bb2e1a
definitions.display_name: Bot Service should have local authentication methods disabled
definitions.description: Disabling local authentication methods improves security by ensuring that a bot uses AAD exclusively for authentication.

Being zone aligned does not guarantee resilience, but it is the foundation on which a resilient solution can be built (e.g. three Virtual Machine Scale Sets zone aligned to three different zones in the same region with a load balancer). See https://aka.ms/AZResilience for more info.

initiatives.name: d5264498-16f4-418a-b659-fa7ef418175f
initiatives.display_name: FedRAMP High
initiatives.description: FedRAMP is a US government-wide program that provides a standardized approach to security assessment, authorization, and continuous monitoring for cloud-based products and services. FedRAMP defines a set of controls for Low, Moderate, or High security impact level systems based on NIST baseline controls. These policies address a subset of FedRAMP (High) controls. For more information, visit https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/compliance/offerings/offering-fedramp

initiatives.name: d64f0787-1470-495d-b747-8534ff151e05
initiatives.display_name: Control the use of Container Registry in Mission Platforms
initiatives.description: This policy set applies exclusively to Mission Platform products and services; usage outside of these scopes is not supported. It deploys coordinated Container Registry controls that enforce private network access, tenant isolation, and boundary protection across Mission Platform workloads; refer to https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/container-registry/container-registry-private-link for architectural guidance.

initiatives.name: d71f9441-4a54-41b0-ad12-5fe2ee8380ba
initiatives.display_name: Control the use of Azure SQL in Mission Platforms
initiatives.description: This policy set applies exclusively to Mission Platform products and services; usage outside of these scopes is not supported. It deploys coordinated Azure SQL controls to enforce private networking, outbound restrictions, and customer-managed encryption for mission workloads (see https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-sql/database/security-overview).
